parameters.content:
## Loopool
A fair queue for pool tables plus a camera referee, run by n8n.

**Three ways in**
1. **Pool API**: the app, the bar TV, the counter tablet and the camera service (`/webhook/pool?action=...`).
2. **Email links**: players check in, vote on a foul or confirm a result straight from their email (`/webhook/pool-act`).
3. **Ask the referee**: an AI agent answers questions about the rules and the live board (`/webhook/pool-ask`).

All three go through one **Referee engine** (queue, 8-ball rules, foul reviews, Elo ratings; state in this workflow's static data), then a **router** sends the answer back the right way. Messages for players go out by **Gmail**.

### Optional: an external camera service → n8n
Instead of the camera page, a vision service (like the OpenCV experiment in experiments/) can call
`/webhook/pool?action=shot&table=T1&event={...}`
with the potted balls, the first ball hit, a confidence score and the ball positions. Below 80% confidence the engine pauses play for a player review.

options.systemMessage:
You are the live commentator on the bar TV at a pool hall, speaking right after each shot.
Write one or two short sentences, 32 words at most, about the shot that just happened: what the shooter did, any foul and what it costs, and what it means for the game (balls left, who shoots next, ball in hand, on the 8, game over).
Use only the facts given. Never invent spin, speed, difficulty or anything not in the facts. No markdown, no emojis, no quotation marks.

=You are the friendly referee and host at Loopool, answering a player on their phone.
Answer in at most 3 short sentences, in plain words, without markdown. Use only the house rules and the live board below. If the answer is not there, say you don't know and suggest asking staff at the counter. Never invent players, times or rules.

HOUSE RULES
- Winner stays on. A table holder can win at most 3 games in a row while people are waiting, then the table goes to the next players.
- When you are called, you have 3 minutes to check in at the table (on your phone or from the email), or the next name on the board is called.
- Table 1 has the camera referee and its games are rated (Elo, K = 32). Tables 2 to 4 are not rated. A game there is called by the camera referee only if staff have a camera running over that table when it starts; otherwise players report the winner and both confirm.
- The camera referee (an AI reading photos of each shot) calls a foul on its own when it is at least 60% sure. Below that, play pauses and both players vote on their phones. If they disagree, staff decide on the counter tablet. Staff can also undo any call.
- 8-ball, simplified: the table is open until someone legally pots a ball, which sets solids (1-7) or stripes (9-15). On each shot you must hit a ball of your own group first, or the 8 once your group is cleared. On the break any ball may be hit first.
- Fouls: the cue ball goes in a pocket (scratch), the cue ball hits nothing, or the wrong ball is hit first. After a foul the other player has ball in hand. Potting the 8 before your group is cleared, or on a foul, loses the game.
- Not checked by the camera: a ball reaching a cushion after contact, double hits, and balls touched by hand. Staff decide those.

LIVE BOARD
{{ $json.brief }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, answer: $json.output || "Sorry, I can't answer that right now. Ask the staff at the counter." }) }}

parameters.content:
### Camera photos → AI referee
The camera screen (`#camera`) spots each shot by motion and posts the photos to `/webhook/pool-score`: before, up to 4 in-between, after, a change map, and the table's ball colours.
**AI reads the shot** (Claude Haiku 5.5 on n8n Gateway credits; see reports/accuracy-and-cost.html) describes it; **Score the shot** turns that into a 0-100 score with a fixed rubric; the **Referee engine** applies turns, groups, fouls, winner and ratings. The after-photo is kept for the bar TV (`/webhook/pool-frame`).

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<style>:root{padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}</style>
<title>Loopool</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<meta name="description" content="Pool hall queue and camera referee demo: join by QR, get called to a table, live foul review, ratings, and a livestream for the bar TVs.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Big+Shoulders:wght@600;800&family=Gochi+Hand&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
/* "Chalkboard": one deliberate dark look for a dim bar. Slate board ground, chalk-white text, chalk-blue actions,
   amber raffle-ticket stubs, chalk lettering for names, felt and wood only where a real table is drawn.
   Presenter layout: phone in a bezel on the left; bar TV and counter tablet stacked on the right. */
:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --board: #1c2723; --board-2: #233029; --board-3: #2a3832; --chalkboard: #26352f; --tv: #121a17; --tray: #111916;
  --line: #33413b; --line-2: #3a4842; --line-3: #5b6a63;
  --chalk: #ecefe9; --dim: #a4afa8; --faint: #8e9b94;
  --blue: #5b9be8; --blue-ink: #0e1714; --blue-text: #8fbcf2;
  --brass: #e5ad3e; --ticket: #ebbb4e; --ticket-ink: #2b1e06;
  --felt: #1f6b47; --felt-edge: #175a3c; --rail: #5a3b24; --pocket: #0b0f0d; --felt-ink: #dff0e6;
  --foul: #ff7a6b; --foul-ink: #2a0d09; --good: #67d394;
  --f-sign: "Big Shoulders", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", sans-serif;
  --f-chalk: "Gochi Hand", "Comic Sans MS", "Chalkboard SE", cursive;
  --f-body: "Instrument Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --f-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }   /* hidden always wins over a display rule */
html, body { margin: 0; }
body { background: var(--board); color: var(--chalk); font: 15px/1.45 var(--f-body); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
body::before { content: ""; position: fixed; inset: 0 0 auto; height: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 10; background: var(--tv); }
button, input { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-text); outline-offset: 2px; }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin: 0; }
h1, h2, h3 { text-wrap: balance; }
a { color: var(--blue-text); }
.mono { font-family: var(--f-mono); }
.num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.dim { color: var(--dim); }
.sign { font-family: var(--f-sign); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: .95; }
.chalk { font-family: var(--f-chalk); font-weight: 400; }
.label { font: 500 11px/1.3 var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); }
.wrap { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); }

/* page chrome */
.top { position: sticky; top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 8; background: var(--tv); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.top .wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px 28px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-block: 10px 0; }
.mark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-right: auto; min-height: 44px; }
.mark b { font: 800 22px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .06em; }
.mark span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); }
.views { display: flex; gap: 22px; overflow-x: auto; max-width: 100%; scrollbar-width: none; }
.views::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.views a { color: var(--dim); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 0 11px; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; }
.views a.on { color: var(--chalk); border-bottom-color: var(--brass); }
.src { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 10px; font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); white-space: nowrap; }
.src::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--faint); }
.src.live::before { background: var(--good); }
.src.err::before { background: var(--foul); }
.controls { background: var(--board-2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.controls .wrap { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-block: 8px; }
.controls .clock { font: 800 20px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .04em; margin-right: 6px; }
.b { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: transparent; color: var(--chalk); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; }
.b:hover { border-color: var(--line-3); }
.b:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.b.go { background: var(--blue); border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--blue-ink); }
.b.on { border-color: var(--brass); color: var(--brass); }
.evchip { font: 400 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); background: none; border: 0; text-decoration: underline dotted; text-underline-offset: 3px; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 4px; }

main { padding-block: 22px 44px; }
.view { display: none; }
.view.on { display: block; }
.presenter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 410px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 28px; align-items: start; }
.col { display: grid; gap: 26px; min-width: 0; }
.cap { margin: 0 0 10px 2px; }
footer { color: var(--faint); font-size: 12.5px; padding-block: 0 28px; }
body.kiosk header.top, body.kiosk footer { display: none; }
.staffbox { margin-top: 18px; background: var(--board-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; padding: 16px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.staffbox .sb-hd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.staffbox .sb-hd .sign { font-size: 24px; margin-right: 8px; }
.staffbox .sb-hd .label { margin: 0; }
.staffbox .sb-now { font-size: 14px; color: var(--dim); }
.staffbox .sb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px 30px; align-items: flex-start; }
.staffbox .sb-g { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.staffbox .sb-g .label { margin: 0; }
.staffbox .sb-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.staffbox .sb-w { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); }
.staffbox .sb-row > .sb-w:first-child { min-width: 52px; }
.staffbox input, .staffbox select { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--board); color: var(--chalk); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; }
.staffbox input { width: 132px; font: 19px/1 var(--f-chalk); }
.staffbox input::placeholder { font: 14px var(--f-body); color: var(--faint); }
.staffbox select:disabled { opacity: .4; }
.b.danger { border-color: #5a2a2a; color: var(--foul); }
.b.danger.fill { background: var(--foul); border-color: var(--foul); color: var(--foul-ink); }
.shotphoto { position: relative; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #0b0f0d; }
.shotphoto img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.shotphoto .cap { position: absolute; left: 10px; bottom: 10px; font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: #fff; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; }
.scorechip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.scorechip b { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid currentColor; font: 800 17px/1 var(--f-sign); }
.scorechip span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); }
.tipline { margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border-left: 3px solid var(--good); background: var(--board-2); font-size: 14px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; }
.badge { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--board-3); color: var(--brass); font: 600 10.5px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: 1px; }
.asklog { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-height: 42vh; overflow-y: auto; margin: 4px 0 12px; }
.asklog:empty { display: none; }
.asklog p { margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; max-width: 88%; }
.asklog .q { align-self: flex-end; background: var(--blue); color: var(--blue-ink); }
.asklog .a { align-self: flex-start; background: var(--board-3); color: var(--chalk); }
.asklog .a.wait { color: var(--dim); }
.askbtn { margin-top: 4px; }
body.kiosk main.wrap { max-width: none; padding: 1.5vw; }

/* phone */
.bezel { width: 100%; max-width: 410px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 10px; border-radius: 48px; background: #0a0f0d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line), 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }
.screen { height: 844px; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; border-radius: 38px; background: var(--board); scrollbar-width: none; }
.screen::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.solo .bezel { padding: 0; border-radius: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; max-width: 460px; }
.solo .screen { height: auto; min-height: 70vh; border-radius: 0; overflow: visible; }
.ph { padding: 16px 20px 26px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; min-height: 100%; }
.ph-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; }
.ph-top .sign { font-size: 24px; }
.live-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 12.5px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); text-transform: uppercase; }
.live-tag::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--foul); }
.h1 { font: 800 42px/.95 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .01em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.lede { font-size: 15px; color: var(--dim); }
.cta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 54px; border-radius: 8px; border: 0; background: var(--blue); color: var(--blue-ink); text-decoration: none; font: 800 21px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.cta.foul { background: var(--foul); color: var(--foul-ink); }
.cta.line { background: transparent; color: var(--chalk); border: 1px solid var(--line-3); }
.quiet { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: transparent; color: var(--chalk); font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; }
.quiet:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.push { margin-top: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.two { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }

.floor { position: relative; height: 150px; border-radius: 10px; background: #172019; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.floor.sm { height: 112px; }
.floor .counter { position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; top: 8px; height: 14px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--board-3); font: 500 10px/14px var(--f-mono); color: var(--faint); text-align: center; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.ft { position: absolute; width: calc(50% - 20px); height: 46px; border-radius: 6px; border: 3px solid var(--rail); background: var(--felt); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; padding: 0 8px; }
.floor.sm .ft { height: 34px; }
.ft b { font: 800 20px/1 var(--f-sign); }
.ft small { font: 500 10px var(--f-mono); color: var(--felt-ink); text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ft.ref { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--blue); }
.ft.open { background: transparent; border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--brass); }
.ft.dimmed { opacity: .45; }
.ft.you { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ticket); }
.ft.a { left: 14px; top: 36px; } .ft.b2 { left: 14px; top: 94px; } .ft.c { right: 14px; top: 36px; } .ft.d { right: 14px; top: 94px; }
.floor.sm .ft.a, .floor.sm .ft.c { top: 30px; } .floor.sm .ft.b2, .floor.sm .ft.d { top: 70px; }

.rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.row .n { font: 800 26px/1 var(--f-sign); }
.row .n.ref { color: var(--blue-text); }
.row b { display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }
.row small { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); }
.row .t { font: 500 13px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); text-align: right; }
.rules { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.rules li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }

.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.field label, .field legend { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 0; }
.field input[type=text], .field input[type=tel], .field input[type=email] { height: 50px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--board-2); color: var(--chalk); }
.field input[type=text] { font: 24px var(--f-chalk); }
.field input[type=tel] { font: 500 17px var(--f-mono); }
.field input[type=email] { font: 17px var(--f-body); }
.field input::placeholder { color: var(--faint); }
.field small { font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); }
fieldset { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }
.seg button { height: 50px; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--line-2); background: transparent; font: 800 20px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .04em; }
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--chalk); border-color: var(--chalk); color: var(--board); }
.switch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); cursor: pointer; }
.switch b { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.switch small { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); margin-top: 4px; }
.switch .knob { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 32px; }
.switch input { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 52px; height: 32px; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.switch .knob i { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--board-3); border: 1px solid var(--line-3); transition: background .15s; }
.switch .knob i::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--dim); transition: left .15s, background .15s; }
.switch input:checked + i { background: var(--blue); border-color: var(--blue); }
.switch input:checked + i::after { left: 23px; background: var(--blue-ink); }
.switch input:disabled + i { opacity: .4; }
.switch input:focus-visible + i { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-text); outline-offset: 2px; }

.ticket { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 112px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ticket); color: var(--ticket-ink); }
.ticket .main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 18px 18px 16px; }
.ticket .main .label { color: var(--ticket-ink); }
.ticket .no { font: 800 76px/.85 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .01em; }
.ticket .who { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
.ticket .stub { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 2px; border-left: 2px dashed rgba(43,30,6,.45); padding: 0 10px; text-align: center; }
.ticket .stub b { font: 800 40px/1 var(--f-sign); }
.ticket .stub span { font: 500 11px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.ticket::before, .ticket::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 101px; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--board); }
.ticket::before { top: -11px; } .ticket::after { bottom: -11px; }
.stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line-2); min-width: 0; }
.stat b { font: 800 32px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .01em; }
.stat span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); }

.board { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 18px 18px; border: 5px solid var(--rail); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--chalkboard); }
.board ol { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 26px/1.15 var(--f-chalk); }
.board li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; }
.board li small { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); white-space: nowrap; }
.board li.done { color: var(--faint); }
.board li.done > span { text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }
.board li.me > span { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--brass); text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-underline-offset: 5px; }
.board li.me small { color: var(--brass); }
.board .empty { font: 22px var(--f-chalk); color: var(--dim); }
.sms { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.sms p { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 14px 14px 14px 4px; background: var(--board-3); font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.4; }
.sms small { font-size: 12px; color: var(--faint); }

.ready { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 22px 20px 20px; border: 6px solid var(--rail); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--felt); }
.ready .label { color: var(--felt-ink); }
.ready .big { font: 800 82px/.85 var(--f-sign); }
.ready .count { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
.ready .count b { font: 800 48px/1 var(--f-sign); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ready .count span { font-size: 15px; color: var(--felt-ink); }
.versus { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.versus .p { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.versus .p.r { align-items: flex-end; text-align: right; }
.versus .p .chalk { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; }
.versus .p small { font: 500 13px/1.35 var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); }
.versus .x { font: 800 18px var(--f-sign); color: var(--faint); }
.tally { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--brass); }

.player { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--board-2); }
.player.turn { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--blue); }
.player .hd { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
.player .chalk { font-size: 28px; line-height: 1; }
.player .chalk small { font: 13px var(--f-body); color: var(--dim); margin-left: 4px; }
.player .flag { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
.player .flag.shoot { color: var(--blue-text); }
.player .flag.hold { color: var(--brass); }
.tray { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 15px; background: var(--tray); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.7); }
.tray .open { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--faint); padding-left: 6px; }
.ball { flex: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3); }
.ball i { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f4f4ee; color: #111; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 700 7.5px/1 var(--f-body); font-style: normal; }
.tbl { line-height: 0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.tbl svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.replay { position: relative; }
.cliptag { margin-top: 8px; font: 500 11.5px/1.4 var(--f-mono); color: var(--faint); }
.lastshot { font-size: 15px; }
.lastshot > .dim:first-child { margin-right: 4px; }
.log { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-size: 14px; }
.log li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.log li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.log .n { font: 500 13px var(--f-mono); color: var(--faint); }
.bad { color: var(--foul); }
.meter { position: relative; height: 10px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--board-3); }
.meter i { display: block; height: 10px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--foul); }
.meter b { position: absolute; left: 80%; top: -4px; width: 2px; height: 18px; background: var(--chalk); }
.vote { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); min-width: 0; }
.vote.wait { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--line-3); }
.vote .chalk { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; }
.vote span:last-child { font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); }
.vote .yes { color: var(--good) !important; } .vote .no { color: var(--foul) !important; }
.won .big { font: 800 96px/.85 var(--f-sign); text-transform: uppercase; }
.won .delta { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; }
.won .delta b { font: 800 44px/1 var(--f-sign); color: var(--brass); }
.won .delta b.down { color: var(--foul); }
.won .delta span { font: 500 15px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); }
.hold { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--board-2); }
.hold .hd { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.hold .hd b { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }
.lb { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.lb div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 15px; }
.lb div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.lb span:first-child { font: 500 13px var(--f-mono); color: var(--faint); }
.lb span:last-child { font: 500 14px var(--f-mono); }
.lb div.me { color: var(--ticket); font-weight: 600; }
.lb div.me span:nth-child(2) { font: 22px/1 var(--f-chalk); }

/* bar TV */
.tv { background: var(--tv); border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tv-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.tv-top .t { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.onair { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--foul); color: var(--foul-ink); font: 800 18px/1.1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.tv-top .sign { font-size: 28px; }
.tv-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 280px; gap: 22px; }
.tv-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.score { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--board); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.score .p { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.score .p.r { align-items: flex-end; text-align: right; }
.score .chalk { font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; }
.score .chalk small { font: 14px var(--f-body); color: var(--dim); }
.score .p.turn .chalk { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--blue); text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-underline-offset: 6px; }
.score .tray { width: max-content; max-width: 100%; }
.score .mid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; font: 800 14px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--dim); }
.score .mid b { font-size: 40px; color: var(--chalk); letter-spacing: 0; }
.tvtable { position: relative; line-height: 0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.tvtable svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.banner { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 18px; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--foul); color: var(--foul-ink); font: 800 19px/1.1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .08em; white-space: nowrap; max-width: calc(100% - 24px); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.banner.win { background: var(--ticket); color: var(--ticket-ink); }
.idle { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.35; background: rgba(12,18,16,.55); }
.idle b { display: block; font: 800 30px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; }
/* the latest line, then older lines only where the column has room for them (whole lines, never cut) */
.ticker { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1 0 auto; margin-top: 14px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--board); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.35; }
.ticker p { margin: 0; }
.ticker .now { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; min-height: 24px; }
.ticker b { font: 800 17px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--brass); white-space: nowrap; }
.ticker b.ai { color: var(--blue-text); }
.ticker .older { position: relative; flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.ticker .older > div { position: absolute; inset: 6px 0 0; display: flex; flex-flow: column wrap; align-content: flex-start; gap: 4px 60px; }
.ticker .older p { width: 100%; font-size: .9em; color: var(--dim); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ailine { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--board-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; }
.ailine b { font: 800 14px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--blue-text); }
/* right column: queue, last shot (or tonight's results), ratings, QR code. The ratings give up rows when the queue is
   long; the QR code grows when there is room (a bigger code scans from further away). */
.aside { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; }
.aside > * { flex: none; }
.tv .board li > span:first-child { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.tv .board li > span:first-child::after { content: ""; flex: 1; min-width: 10px; border-bottom: 2px dotted var(--line-3); transform: translateY(-.18em); }
.shotcard, .tvres { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.shotcard .sc { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.shotcard .sc p { margin: 0; min-width: 0; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.35; }
.shotcard .sc strong { margin-right: 3px; font: 800 1.05em/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.ring { flex: none; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid currentColor; font: 800 19px/1 var(--f-sign); }
.tvres .rs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.3; }
.tvres .rs > div { padding: 4px 0; }
.tvres .rs small { margin-left: 9px; font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); white-space: nowrap; }
.aside .ratings { flex: 0 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
.ratings { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; --rt-row: 30px; font-size: 15.5px; }
.ratings .rt { display: flex; flex-flow: column wrap; align-content: flex-start; flex: 0 1 auto; height: calc(var(--rt-row) * 3); min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.ratings .rt > div { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; width: 50%; height: var(--rt-row); line-height: var(--rt-row); padding-right: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.ratings .rk { font: 500 .8em var(--f-mono); color: var(--faint); }
.ratings .nm { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ratings .pts { font: 500 .88em var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); }
.honours { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); }
.aside .qrline { flex: 1 0 96px; min-height: 0; max-height: 132px; }
.aside .qrbox { width: auto; height: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; }
.aside .qrbox img { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.qrline { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; }
.qrbox { width: 96px; height: 96px; flex: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; padding: 6px; display: grid; place-items: center; line-height: 0; }
.qrbox img { width: 84px; height: 84px; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.qrline .sign { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.05; }

/* counter tablet */
.tablet { background: var(--board-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 22px; padding: 20px 22px; }
.tab-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.tab-top .sign { font-size: 30px; }
.tab-top .clock { font: 800 28px/1 var(--f-sign); }
.tgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
.tables { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.tcard { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--board); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tcard.staff { border-color: var(--foul); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--foul); }
.tcard .hd { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
.tcard .hd .sign { font-size: 24px; }
.tcard .st { font: 500 11.5px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.st.play { color: var(--good); } .st.wait { color: var(--brass); } .st.alert { color: var(--foul); } .st.free { color: var(--faint); }
.tcard .meta { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); }
.tcard .felt { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--felt); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--rail); margin: 2px 0 4px; }
.seat { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
.seat .chalk { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.1; }
.seat small { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); white-space: nowrap; }
.decide { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.decide button { min-height: 44px; border-radius: 6px; font: 800 16px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .06em; border: 1px solid var(--line-3); background: transparent; }
.decide button.uphold { background: var(--foul); color: var(--foul-ink); border-color: var(--foul); }
.results { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.results div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 14px; }
.results div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.results small { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--dim); }
.activity { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.activity div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 13.5px; }
.activity div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.activity .tm { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--faint); }
.activity .todo span:last-child { color: var(--foul); font-weight: 600; }
.activity .todo svg { vertical-align: -3px; margin-right: 6px; }
.panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

/* dialogs + toast */
dialog { border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 14px; padding: 0; background: var(--board-2); color: var(--chalk); width: min(520px, calc(100vw - 32px)); box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.55); }
dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(5,9,8,.7); }
.dlg { padding: 22px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.dlg h3 { font: 800 28px/1 var(--f-sign); letter-spacing: .03em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.dlg p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--dim); }
.dlg input { height: 46px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--board); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 14px var(--f-mono); color: var(--chalk); }
.dlg #askInput { font: 16px var(--f-body); }
.dlg .row2 { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; }
#confirmDlg { width: min(440px, calc(100vw - 32px)); }
#confirmDlg p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--chalk); }
#confirmDlg .b { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 15px; }
.dlg pre { margin: 0; background: var(--board); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; font: 12px/1.5 var(--f-mono); max-height: 340px; overflow: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; color: var(--dim); }
.toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(16px); background: var(--chalk); color: var(--board); padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0; transition: .25s; pointer-events: none; z-index: 30; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); }
.toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }

@media (max-width: 1120px) { .presenter { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .tv-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .aside { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); } .aside .qrline { max-height: none; } .aside .qrbox { height: 96px; align-self: center; } }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .tgrid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .tables { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .mark span { display: none; } .evchip { display: none; } .score .chalk { font-size: 24px; } .tv { padding: 16px; } .tablet { padding: 16px; } }
/* Bar TV as signage (switched on by fitTV): one 16:9 canvas, 1280 x 720, scaled to the screen with zoom. Sizes here are
   canvas pixels; a 1080p TV shows them 1.5 times larger. The picture column is as wide as the table can be at this
   height and the right column takes the rest, so the screen never scrolls and no part of it is left empty. */
.tvfit .tv { width: 1280px; height: 720px; zoom: var(--tvz, 1); padding: 24px 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
body.tvfull { background: var(--tv); overflow: hidden; }
body.tvfull main.wrap { padding: 0; }
body.tvfull [data-tv] { height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center; }
body.tvfull .tv { border: 0; border-radius: 0; }
.tvfit .tv-top { flex: none; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.tvfit .tv-top .sign { font-size: 34px; }
.tvfit .onair { font-size: 21px; padding: 5px 12px; }
.tvfit .tv-top .mark b { font-size: 26px; }
.tvfit .tv-grid { flex: 1; min-height: 0; grid-template-columns: 770px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 26px; }
.tvfit .tv-main { min-height: 0; }
.tvfit .score { flex: none; padding: 12px 18px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.tvfit .score .chalk { font-size: 40px; }
.tvfit .score .chalk small { font-size: 17px; }
.tvfit .score .tray { min-height: 38px; border-radius: 19px; gap: 5px; padding: 0 6px; }
.tvfit .score .tray .open { font-size: 15px; }
.tvfit .score .ball { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
.tvfit .score .ball i { width: 14px; height: 14px; font-size: 9.5px; }
.tvfit .score .mid { font-size: 16px; }
.tvfit .score .mid b { font-size: 46px; }
.tvfit .tvtable { flex: 0 1 auto; min-height: 0; margin-block: auto; aspect-ratio: 1096 / 596; }
.tvfit .tvtable [data-tbl], .tvfit .tvtable .shotphoto, .tvfit .tvtable svg { height: 100%; }
.tvfit .tvtable .shotphoto { display: flex; justify-content: center; background: none; }
.tvfit .tvtable .shotphoto img { width: auto; max-width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 10px; object-fit: contain; }
.tvfit .shotphoto .cap { left: 14px; bottom: 14px; font-size: 15px; }
.tvfit .banner { padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 26px; }
.tvfit .idle { font-size: 21px; }
.tvfit .idle b { font-size: 42px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.tvfit .ticker { flex: 0 0 80px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 12px; padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 20px; overflow: hidden; }
.tvfit .ticker b { font-size: 20px; }
.tvfit .ticker .now span { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; overflow: hidden; }
.tvfit .aside { display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: space-between; }
.tvfit .label { font-size: 13.5px; }
.tvfit .board { padding: 12px 18px 14px; gap: 6px; }
.tvfit .board ol { font-size: 29px; gap: 3px; }
.tvfit .board li small { font-size: 15px; }
.tvfit .board .empty { font-size: 26px; }
.tvfit .shotcard .sc p, .tvfit .tvres .rs { font-size: 19px; }
.tvfit .ring { width: 58px; height: 58px; border-width: 4px; font-size: 25px; }
.tvfit .shotcard .tipline { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; overflow: hidden; font-size: 17px; }
.tvfit .tvres .rs small { font-size: 14px; }
.tvfit .ratings { --rt-row: 34px; font-size: 19px; }
.tvfit .honours { font-size: 15px; }
.tvfit .badge { font-size: 12px; }
.tvfit .aside .qrline { max-height: 230px; gap: 18px; }
.tvfit .aside .qrbox { height: 100%; align-self: auto; }
.tvfit .qrline .sign { font-size: 30px; }
/* bar setup (#business) and events on the player phone: same chalkboard look as the counter tablet */
.biz-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px; align-items: start; }
.biz-card { background: var(--board); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; }
.biz-hd { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.biz-hd .sign { font-size: 24px; }
.biz-hd .dim { font-size: 13.5px; }
.biz-pill { margin-left: auto; font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 99px; border: 1px solid var(--line-3); color: var(--dim); }
.biz-pill.on { border-color: var(--good); color: var(--good); }
.biz-steps { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: st; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.biz-steps li { counter-increment: st; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 10px; row-gap: 6px; }
.biz-steps li::before { content: counter(st); grid-row: span 4; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--line-3); display: grid; place-items: center; font: 800 16px/1 var(--f-sign); color: var(--dim); }
.biz-steps li.done::before { content: "\2713"; border-color: var(--good); color: var(--good); }
.biz-steps b { font-size: 15px; }
.biz-steps .dim { font-size: 13.5px; }
.biz-cams { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.biz-cam { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--board-3); color: var(--dim); }
.biz-cam.on { color: var(--good); }
.biz-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
a.b { text-decoration: none; }
.biz-form { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px 14px; }
.biz-form .wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.biz-f { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.biz-f label { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.biz-f small { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--dim); }
.biz input, .biz select, .biz textarea { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--board-2); color: var(--chalk); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; color-scheme: dark; }
.biz textarea { resize: vertical; }
.biz [hidden] { display: none !important; }
.biz input::placeholder, .biz textarea::placeholder { color: var(--faint); }
.biz-hours { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

<script>
// ===== Pool Referee engine. The same code runs in the browser demo and inside the n8n workflow. =====
const RULES = { maxWins: 3, checkinSec: 180, simCheckinSec: 40, simVoteSec: 3, simConfirmSec: 3, avgGameMin: { '8-ball': 14, '9-ball': 11, '10-ball': 12 }, k: 32, startRating: 1200, games: ['8-ball', '9-ball', '10-ball'], aiReviewBelow: 0.6, undoDepth: 8 };
// Balls on the table at the start of each game type.
const BALLS = gt => Array.from({ length: gt === '9-ball' ? 9 : gt === '10-ball' ? 10 : 15 }, (_, i) => i + 1);
const TABLE = { W: 1000, H: 500, R: 11, pockets: [[0, 0], [500, -6], [1000, 0], [0, 500], [500, 506], [1000, 500]] };
const MIN = 60000;
// A table has a camera while a camera page is running for it: the page names its tables on every state poll
// (?cams=T1,T2), so a camera counts as gone once it has not reported for CAM_TTL. Table 1 (t.ref) always has one.
const CAM_TTL = MIN, CAM_SAVE_EVERY = 20000;
function camOn(t, now) { return !!t.camAt && now - t.camAt < CAM_TTL; }
function refereed(t, now) { return !!t.ref || camOn(t, now); }
function groupOf(b) { b = Number(b); return b === 8 ? 'eight' : b < 8 ? 'solids' : 'stripes'; }
function otherSide(s) { return s === 'champ' ? 'challenger' : 'champ'; }
function hashStr(s) { let h = 2166136261; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); } return h >>> 0; }
function clone(o) { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o)); }

function rackPositions() {
  const R = TABLE.R, rows = [[1], [10, 2], [3, 8, 11], [12, 5, 13, 4], [6, 14, 7, 15, 9]];
  const pos = { cue: [250, 250] };
  rows.forEach((row, i) => row.forEach((b, j) => { pos[b] = [Math.round(750 + i * (2 * R * 0.87 + 0.6)), Math.round(250 + (j - i / 2) * (2 * R + 0.8))]; }));
  return pos;
}

function seedState(now) {
  const P = (name, rating, w, l) => ({ name, rating, w, l });
  const seat = (pid, name) => ({ pid, name, ticket: null, real: false, present: true });
  return {
    v: 1, skew: 0, seq: 101, createdAt: now, flags: {},
    venue: venueProfile({ name: 'Loopool', note: 'Demo venue · fake players', address: '6133 University Blvd, Vancouver', tableBrand: 'Diamond', tableSize: '8 ft', cues: 12, about: 'Four tables, a camera referee on Table 1 and a fair queue for everyone.', setup: true, lat: 49.2661, lng: -123.2497 }, 4),
    events: seedEvents(now),
    directory: seedDirectory(now),
    players: {
      p_sam: P('Sam', 1340, 18, 9), p_lee: P('Lee', 1255, 11, 10), p_ana: P('Ana', 1410, 24, 8), p_kai: P('Kai', 1175, 6, 9),
      p_noor: P('Noor', 1305, 15, 11), p_jules: P('Jules', 1230, 9, 9), p_kim: P('Kim', 1265, 12, 10), p_ravi: P('Ravi', 1190, 7, 9),
      p_priya: P('Priya', 1190, 5, 6), p_diego: P('Diego', 1280, 13, 10),
    },
    tables: [
      { id: 'T1', name: 'Table 1', ref: true, gameType: '8-ball', champ: seat('p_sam', 'Sam'), challenger: seat('p_lee', 'Lee'), streak: 1, game: { id: 'g1', mode: 'sim', rated: true, startedAt: now - 9 * MIN, endsAt: now + 5 * MIN, simWinner: 'champ' } },
      { id: 'T2', name: 'Table 2', ref: false, gameType: '9-ball', champ: seat('p_ana', 'Ana'), challenger: seat('p_kai', 'Kai'), streak: 2, game: { id: 'g2', mode: 'sim', rated: false, startedAt: now - 4 * MIN, endsAt: now + 16 * MIN, simWinner: 'champ' } },
      { id: 'T3', name: 'Table 3', ref: false, gameType: '8-ball', champ: seat('p_noor', 'Noor'), challenger: seat('p_jules', 'Jules'), streak: 1, game: { id: 'g3', mode: 'sim', rated: false, startedAt: now - 12 * MIN, endsAt: now + 3 * MIN, simWinner: 'challenger' } },
      { id: 'T4', name: 'Table 4', ref: false, gameType: '9-ball', champ: seat('p_kim', 'Kim'), challenger: seat('p_ravi', 'Ravi'), streak: 1, game: { id: 'g4', mode: 'sim', rated: false, startedAt: now - 2 * MIN, endsAt: now + 22 * MIN, simWinner: 'champ' } },
    ],
    queue: [{ ticket: 'A101', pid: 'p_priya', name: 'Priya', gameType: '8-ball', refOnly: false, real: false, status: 'waiting', joinedAt: now - 4 * MIN }],
    scheduled: [],
    history: [
      { at: now - 21 * MIN, table: 'Table 1', winner: 'Sam', loser: 'Ana', rated: true, delta: 19 },
      { at: now - 34 * MIN, table: 'Table 1', winner: 'Ana', loser: 'Kim', rated: true, delta: 12 },
    ],
    feed: [{ at: now - 60000, kind: 'table', text: 'Sam and Lee are playing a rated game on Table 1' }],
    outbox: [],
  };
}

function log(S, now, kind, text, ref) { S.feed.push(Object.assign({ at: now, kind, text }, ref || {})); if (S.feed.length > 40) S.feed.splice(0, S.feed.length - 40); }
// A message to one player. n8n emails it when the player gave an address. Buttons become links back to n8n
// ({base}/pool-act?a=checkin&t=A102&k=key), so players can check in, vote on a foul or confirm a result from the email.
// The key is per ticket and never leaves the server except inside that player's own emails.
const LINK_ACTIONS = ['checkin', 'vote', 'confirm', 'leave'];
function actLink(S, q, action, vote) { return (S.base || '') + '/pool-act?a=' + action + '&t=' + encodeURIComponent(q.ticket) + '&k=' + q.key + (vote ? '&v=' + vote : ''); }
function text(S, now, ticket, msg, notes, opts) {
  const q = S.queue.find(x => x.ticket === ticket); if (!q || !q.real) return;
  opts = opts || {};
  const n = { at: now, ticket, name: q.name, email: q.email || '', subject: opts.subject || msg, text: msg,
    buttons: (opts.buttons || []).map(b => ({ label: b[0], url: actLink(S, q, b[1], b[2]), style: b[3] || '' })),
    page: (S.base || '') + '/pool-app#mobile&t=' + encodeURIComponent(q.ticket) };
  S.outbox.push({ at: n.at, ticket, text: msg }); if (S.outbox.length > 40) S.outbox.splice(0, S.outbox.length - 40);
  if (q.email) notes.push(n);
}
function textSeats(S, t, now, notes, msgFor, opts) {
  ['champ', 'challenger'].forEach(side => { const s = t[side]; if (s && s.ticket) text(S, now, s.ticket, msgFor(side), notes, typeof opts === 'function' ? opts(side) : opts); });
}
function eligible(q, t) { return q.status === 'waiting' && q.gameType === t.gameType && (!q.refOnly || t.ref); }
function seatFromTicket(q, now) { return { pid: q.pid, name: q.name, ticket: q.ticket, real: !!q.real, present: false, calledAt: now }; }

// Player stats (shots scored by the AI, fouls, best shot) for the leaderboard and badges.
function stat(S, pid) { const p = S.players[pid]; if (!p) return null; if (p.shots == null) Object.assign(p, { shots: 0, scoreSum: 0, fouls: 0, best: 0 }); return p; }
function findPid(S, name, create) {
  const n = String(name || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 24); if (!n) return null;
  let pid = Object.keys(S.players).find(k => S.players[k].name.toLowerCase() === n.toLowerCase());
  if (!pid && create) { pid = 'p_' + n.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '') + '_' + (++S.seq); S.players[pid] = { name: n, rating: RULES.startRating, w: 0, l: 0 }; }
  return pid;
}
// Rating change: Elo with K = 48 for a player's first 5 matches, then 32, times a margin
// multiplier (1 + 0.05 x balls the loser still had), plus up to +-5 from the player's average AI shot score this game.
function ratingChange(S, g, W, L, loserLeft) {
  const pw = S.players[W.pid], pl = S.players[L.pid];
  const E = 1 / (1 + Math.pow(10, (pl.rating - pw.rating) / 400));
  const mult = 1 + 0.05 * Math.max(0, Math.min(7, loserLeft || 0));
  const perf = side => { const ss = (g.shots || []).filter(s => s.side === side && s.score != null); return ss.length ? ss.reduce((a, s) => a + s.score, 0) / ss.length : 50; };
  const bonus = v => Math.max(-5, Math.min(5, (v - 50) / 10));
  const K = p => ((p.w || 0) + (p.l || 0)) < 5 ? 48 : 32;
  return { dW: Math.round(K(pw) * (1 - E) * mult + bonus(perf(W.side))), dL: Math.round(-K(pl) * (1 - E) * mult + bonus(perf(L.side))) };
}

function startGame(S, t, now) {
  const real = t.champ.real || t.challenger.real || t.champ.staff || t.challenger.staff;   // staff-started matches are played for real too
  const mode = refereed(t, now) && real ? 'camera' : real ? 'manual' : 'sim';   // any table with a running camera is refereed; only Table 1 is rated
  const id = 'g' + (++S.seq);
  const g = { id, mode, rated: t.ref, startedAt: now, status: 'live' };
  if (mode === 'sim') {
    const h = hashStr(t.champ.pid + t.challenger.pid + id);
    g.endsAt = now + (RULES.avgGameMin[t.gameType] - 3 + (h % 7)) * MIN;
    const rc = (S.players[t.champ.pid] || {}).rating || 1200, rh = (S.players[t.challenger.pid] || {}).rating || 1200;
    g.simWinner = (h % 100) < 100 / (1 + Math.pow(10, (rh - rc) / 400)) ? 'champ' : 'challenger';
  }
  if (mode === 'camera') {
    Object.assign(g, { gameType: t.gameType, turn: t.breaker || 'challenger', groups: { champ: null, challenger: null }, onTable: BALLS(t.gameType), positions: t.gameType === '8-ball' ? rackPositions() : null, lastShot: null, shots: [], review: null, ballInHand: false, winner: null, confirm: {} });
  }
  if (mode === 'manual') Object.assign(g, { winner: null, confirm: {} });
  t.game = g; delete t.breaker;
  [t.champ, t.challenger].forEach(s => { const q = S.queue.find(x => x.ticket === s.ticket); if (q) q.status = 'playing'; });
  log(S, now, 'table', t.champ.name + ' vs ' + t.challenger.name + ' started on ' + t.name + (mode === 'camera' ? ' (camera referee)' : ''));
}

function finishGame(S, t, winSide, now, notes, reason) {
  const g = t.game, W = Object.assign({ side: winSide }, t[winSide]), L = Object.assign({ side: otherSide(winSide) }, t[otherSide(winSide)]);
  let delta = 0, lossDelta = 0;
  if (g.rated && S.players[W.pid] && S.players[L.pid]) {
    const lg = g.groups && g.groups[L.side];
    const loserLeft = g.mode === 'camera' && (g.gameType || t.gameType) === '8-ball' ? (lg ? g.onTable.filter(b => groupOf(b) === lg).length : 7) : 0;
    const r = ratingChange(S, g, W, L, loserLeft);
    delta = r.dW; lossDelta = r.dL;
    S.players[W.pid].rating += delta; S.players[L.pid].rating += lossDelta; S.players[W.pid].w++; S.players[L.pid].l++;
  }
  S.finished = (S.finished || 0) + 1;
  S.history.unshift({ at: now, table: t.name, winner: W.name, loser: L.name, rated: g.rated, delta, lossDelta, reason: reason || '' });
  if (S.history.length > 20) S.history.length = 20;
  t.streak = winSide === 'champ' ? t.streak + 1 : 1;
  log(S, now, 'result', W.name + ' beat ' + L.name + ' on ' + t.name + (g.rated ? ' (+' + delta + ' rating)' : '') + (reason ? ' · ' + reason : ''));
  const lq = S.queue.find(x => x.ticket === L.ticket);
  if (lq) { lq.status = 'done'; lq.result = { won: false, gameId: g.id, opponent: W.name, delta: lossDelta, rated: g.rated, rating: (S.players[L.pid] || {}).rating, table: t.name }; text(S, now, lq.ticket, 'Good game! ' + W.name + ' won on ' + t.name + (g.rated ? ' (' + lossDelta + ' rating)' : '') + '. Want another? Put your name back on the board.', notes, { subject: 'Good game on ' + t.name }); }
  const wq = S.queue.find(x => x.ticket === W.ticket);
  if (wq) { wq.result = { won: true, gameId: g.id, opponent: L.name, delta, rated: g.rated, rating: (S.players[W.pid] || {}).rating, table: t.name, streak: t.streak, stayOn: true }; text(S, now, wq.ticket, 'You beat ' + L.name + ' on ' + t.name + (g.rated ? ' (+' + delta + ' rating, now ' + wq.result.rating + ')' : '') + '. Winner stays on, so the table is yours for the next game.', notes, { subject: 'You won on ' + t.name }); }
  t.champ = Object.assign({}, W, { present: true });
  t.challenger = null; t.lastGame = { id: g.id, winner: W.name, loser: L.name, at: now };
  t.game = null;
  const waiting = S.queue.some(q => eligible(q, t));
  if (t.streak >= RULES.maxWins && waiting) {
    log(S, now, 'table', W.name + ' won ' + t.streak + ' in a row and hands over ' + t.name + ' (house rule: max ' + RULES.maxWins + ')');
    if (wq) { wq.status = 'done'; wq.result.stayOn = false; wq.result.retired = true; text(S, now, wq.ticket, 'You won ' + t.streak + ' in a row. House rule: the table goes to the next players now. Nice run!', notes); }
    t.champ = null; t.streak = 0;
  }
}

function resolveReview(S, t, decision, now, by) {
  const g = t.game, r = g.review; if (!r) return;
  const shot = g.shots.find(s => s.no === r.shotNo);
  if (decision === 'foul') {
    g.turn = r.ifFoul; g.ballInHand = true;
    if (shot) { shot.fouls.push(r.foul.text + ' (confirmed' + (by ? ' by ' + by : '') + ')'); shot.possible = []; }
    log(S, now, 'foul', 'Foul confirmed on shot ' + r.shotNo + ': ' + r.foul.text + '. ' + t[r.ifFoul].name + ' has ball in hand');
  } else {
    g.turn = r.ifClean;
    if (shot) { shot.possible = []; shot.cleared = true; }
    log(S, now, 'foul', 'No foul on shot ' + r.shotNo + (by ? ' (' + by + ')' : '') + '. ' + t[r.ifClean].name + ' to shoot');
  }
  g.status = 'live'; g.review = null;
}

function settle(S, now, notes) {
  for (let guard = 0, changed = true; changed && guard < 30; guard++) {
    changed = false;
    // scheduled walk-ins
    S.scheduled.filter(e => e.at <= now).forEach(e => {
      if (e.type === 'join' && !S.queue.some(q => q.pid === e.pid && ['waiting', 'called', 'playing'].includes(q.status))) {
        S.queue.push({ ticket: 'A' + (++S.seq), pid: e.pid, name: e.name, gameType: e.gameType, refOnly: e.refOnly, real: false, status: 'waiting', joinedAt: now });
        log(S, now, 'queue', e.name + ' joined the queue (' + e.gameType + (e.refOnly ? ', camera table only' : '') + ')');
      }
      changed = true;
    });
    S.scheduled = S.scheduled.filter(e => e.at > now);
    for (const t of S.tables) {
      const g = t.game;
      if (g && g.mode === 'sim' && g.endsAt <= now) { finishGame(S, t, g.simWinner, now, notes); changed = true; continue; }
      if (g && g.status === 'review' && g.review) {
        for (const side of ['champ', 'challenger']) {
          if (!t[side].real && !t[side].staff && !g.review.votes[side] && now - g.review.at >= RULES.simVoteSec * 1000) {
            g.review.votes[side] = g.review.source === 'player' && g.review.accused === side ? 'dispute' : 'accept';
            log(S, now, 'foul', t[side].name + (g.review.votes[side] === 'accept' ? ' accepted' : ' disputed') + ' the foul call');
            changed = true;
          }
        }
        const v = g.review.votes;
        if (v.champ && v.challenger && !g.review.staff) {
          if (v.champ === v.challenger) resolveReview(S, t, v.champ === 'accept' ? 'foul' : 'clean', now, 'both players');
          else { g.review.staff = true; log(S, now, 'staff', 'Players disagree on shot ' + g.review.shotNo + ' on ' + t.name + '. Staff decision needed', { table: t.id, game: g.id, shot: g.review.shotNo }); }   // the counter tablet shows this in red until staff decide
          changed = true;
        }
      }
      if (g && g.status === 'confirm') {
        for (const side of ['champ', 'challenger']) {
          if (!t[side].real && !g.confirm[side] && now - g.confirmAt >= RULES.simConfirmSec * 1000) { g.confirm[side] = true; changed = true; }
        }
        if (g.confirm.champ && g.confirm.challenger) { finishGame(S, t, g.winner, now, notes, g.winReason); changed = true; continue; }
      }
      if (!t.game) {
        for (const side of ['champ', 'challenger']) {
          const s = t[side];
          if (!s) continue;
          if (!s.present && !s.real && now - s.calledAt >= RULES.simCheckinSec * 1000) { s.present = true; log(S, now, 'queue', s.name + ' checked in at ' + t.name); changed = true; }
          if (!s.present && s.real && now - s.calledAt >= RULES.checkinSec * 1000) {
            const q = S.queue.find(x => x.ticket === s.ticket);
            if (q) { q.status = 'missed'; text(S, now, q.ticket, 'You missed your turn at ' + t.name + ', so the next name on the board was called. Put your name back on the board any time.', notes, { subject: 'You missed your turn at ' + t.name }); }
            log(S, now, 'queue', s.name + ' missed the check-in for ' + t.name);
            t[side] = null; changed = true;
          }
        }
        if (!t.champ && t.challenger) { t.champ = t.challenger; t.challenger = null; t.streak = 0; changed = true; }
        const called = [];
        for (const side of ['champ', 'challenger']) {
          if (t[side]) continue;
          const q = S.queue.find(x => eligible(x, t));
          if (!q) break;
          q.status = 'called'; q.table = t.id; q.calledAt = now; q.seat = side;
          t[side] = seatFromTicket(q, now);
          log(S, now, 'queue', q.name + ' was called to ' + t.name);
          called.push([q, side]);
          changed = true;
        }
        called.splice(0).forEach(([q, side]) => {   // after both seats are filled, so the email can name the opponent
          const opp = t[side === 'champ' ? 'challenger' : 'champ'];
          text(S, now, q.ticket, 'It\'s your turn! Go to ' + t.name + (opp ? ' to play ' + opp.name : '') + '. Check in within ' + Math.round(RULES.checkinSec / 60) + ' minutes, or your spot goes to the next name on the board.', notes, { subject: 'Your table is ready: ' + t.name + (opp ? ' vs ' + opp.name : ''), buttons: [['I\'m at the table', 'checkin']] });
        });
        if (t.champ && t.challenger && t.champ.present && t.challenger.present) { startGame(S, t, now); changed = true; }
      }
    }
  }
}

function applyShot(S, t, ev, now, notes) {
  notes = notes || [];
  const g = t.game;
  if (!g || g.mode !== 'camera') return 'The camera is not following a game on ' + t.name + ' right now.';
  if (g.status === 'review') return 'Waiting for the foul review on shot ' + g.review.shotNo + '.';
  if (g.status !== 'live') return 'This game is over.';
  const gt = g.gameType || t.gameType || '8-ball', eightBall = gt === '8-ball';
  const side = g.turn, other = otherSide(side), nm = s => t[s].name;
  const before = g.onTable.slice();
  let potted = (ev.potted || []).map(Number).filter(b => before.includes(b));
  const mine = eightBall ? g.groups[side] : null;
  const leftBefore = mine ? before.filter(b => groupOf(b) === mine).length : null;
  const fouls = [], possible = [];
  const ai = ev.ai || null;                                   // the AI's reading of the shot photos
  const reviewBelow = ai ? RULES.aiReviewBelow : 0.8;
  const fcUnknown = ev.firstContact === 'unknown';            // the photos don't show which ball was hit first
  const fc = fcUnknown || ev.firstContact == null || ev.firstContact === '' ? null : Number(ev.firstContact);
  const isBreak = g.shots.length === 0;
  if (fc == null && !fcUnknown) fouls.push({ code: 'no-contact', text: 'Cue ball didn\'t hit any ball' });
  if (ev.cueBallPotted) fouls.push({ code: 'scratch', text: 'Scratch: the cue ball went in a pocket' });
  if (eightBall && fc != null && !isBreak) {                  // on the break any ball may be hit first
    const legal = mine ? (leftBefore > 0 ? groupOf(fc) === mine : fc === 8) : fc !== 8;
    if (!legal) {
      const conf = ev.confidence && ev.confidence.firstContact != null ? Number(ev.confidence.firstContact) : 0.95;
      (conf < reviewBelow ? possible : fouls).push({ code: 'wrong-ball', text: nm(side) + ' hit the ' + fc + ' first', conf });
    }
  }
  if (ai && ai.foul && !fouls.length && !possible.length) {  // a foul only the AI saw in the photos
    const conf = ai.confidence == null ? 0.95 : Number(ai.confidence);
    (conf < reviewBelow ? possible : fouls).push({ code: 'ai', text: ai.foulReason || 'Foul seen by the AI referee', conf });
  }
  const money = gt === '9-ball' ? 9 : gt === '10-ball' ? 10 : 8;
  const respot = !eightBall && potted.includes(money) && (fouls.length || possible.length);
  if (respot) potted = potted.filter(b => b !== money);       // 9/10-ball: the money ball potted on a foul comes back
  g.onTable = before.filter(b => !potted.includes(b));
  const from = g.positions;
  g.positions = ev.positions || (ai ? null : g.positions);    // the AI method sends photos, not ball positions
  g.lastShot = { no: g.shots.length + 1, cuePath: ev.cuePath || null, pockets: ev.pockets || {}, from };
  const shot = { no: g.shots.length + 1, side, shooter: nm(side), potted, firstContact: fc, scratch: !!ev.cueBallPotted, fouls: fouls.map(f => f.text), possible: possible.map(f => f.text + ' (' + Math.round(f.conf * 100) + '% sure)'), at: now, clip: ev.clip ? String(ev.clip).slice(0, 60) : null };
  if (ai) Object.assign(shot, { score: ai.score, grade: ai.grade, tip: ai.tip || '', observations: ai.observations || '', breakdown: ai.breakdown || null, confidence: ai.confidence, needsReview: !!ai.needsReview, ai: ai.observations ? String(ai.observations).slice(0, 240) : null });
  const lines = [];
  const confirmFlow = (winner, why) => {
    g.winner = winner; g.winReason = why; g.status = 'confirm'; g.confirmAt = now; g.confirm = {}; g.turn = null;
    lines.push('Shot ' + shot.no + ': ' + why + '. ' + nm(winner) + ' wins! Waiting for both players to confirm.');
    textSeats(S, t, now, notes, s => why + '. ' + (s === winner ? 'You win!' : nm(winner) + ' wins.') + ' Confirm the result so the ratings update.', { subject: 'Game over on ' + t.name + ': please confirm', buttons: [['Confirm result', 'confirm']] });
  };
  if (eightBall && potted.includes(8) && !isBreak) {
    const cleared = mine && leftBefore === 0;
    const ok = cleared && !fouls.length && !possible.length;
    confirmFlow(ok ? side : other, ok ? nm(side) + ' potted the 8' : (cleared ? nm(side) + ' fouled on the 8' : nm(side) + ' potted the 8 too early'));
  } else if (!eightBall && potted.includes(money)) {
    confirmFlow(side, nm(side) + ' potted the ' + money);
  } else {
    if (eightBall && !mine && !fouls.length && !possible.length && potted.length && !isBreak) {
      // open table: the first legal pot after the break sets the groups (majority if both kinds went down)
      const s1 = potted.filter(b => groupOf(b) === 'solids').length, s2 = potted.filter(b => groupOf(b) === 'stripes').length;
      if (s1 || s2) { const grp = s1 >= s2 ? 'solids' : 'stripes'; g.groups[side] = grp; g.groups[other] = grp === 'solids' ? 'stripes' : 'solids'; shot.note = nm(side) + ' takes ' + grp; lines.push(nm(side) + ' takes ' + grp); }
    }
    const own = eightBall ? (g.groups[side] ? potted.some(b => groupOf(b) === g.groups[side]) : potted.length > 0) : potted.length > 0;
    const desc = 'Shot ' + shot.no + ' · ' + nm(side) + (potted.length ? ' potted ' + potted.join(' and ') : ' missed') + (respot ? ' (the ' + money + ' comes back on a foul)' : '');
    if (possible.length) {

// ===== Demo "camera service": builds the shot events a real vision system would send to n8n. =====
// One scripted 8-ball game. Roles come from the engine's turn order, so the challenger plays the stripes here.
const SHOT_SPEC = [
  { brk: true, pot: [10] },
  { target: 12, pot: true },
  { target: 13, pot: false },
  { target: 2, pot: true },
  { target: 5, pot: true },
  { target: 11, pot: false, conf: 0.62 },
  { target: 9, pot: true, bih: true },
  { target: 14, pot: true },
  { target: 11, pot: true, extra: [15] },
  { target: 13, pot: true, scratch: true },
  { target: 1, pot: true, bih: true },
  { target: 3, pot: true },
  { target: 4, pot: false },
  { target: 8, pot: true },
];
function mulberry32(a) { return function () { a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0; let t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a); t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t; return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; }
function buildScript() {
  const R = TABLE.R, W = TABLE.W, H = TABLE.H, P = TABLE.pockets;
  const rnd = mulberry32(20261118);
  const d = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]);
  const round = p => [Math.round(p[0]), Math.round(p[1])];
  let pos = rackPositions();
  const free = (p, ignore) => p[0] > R + 6 && p[0] < W - R - 6 && p[1] > R + 6 && p[1] < H - R - 6 && P.every(q => d(p, q) > 48) && Object.entries(pos).every(([k, q]) => ignore.includes(k) || d(p, q) > 2 * R + 4);
  const spot = (ignore, x0, x1, y0, y1) => { for (let i = 0; i < 800; i++) { const p = [x0 + rnd() * (x1 - x0), y0 + rnd() * (y1 - y0)]; if (free(p, ignore)) return round(p); } return [W / 2, H / 2]; };
  const nearest = p => P.reduce((bi, q, i) => d(p, q) < d(p, P[bi]) ? i : bi, 0);
  const events = [];
  SHOT_SPEC.forEach((s, idx) => {
    const ev = { shotNo: idx + 1, potted: [], cueBallPotted: false, firstContact: null, confidence: {}, cuePath: null, pockets: {}, clip: 'table1_shot' + String(idx + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '.mp4' };
    if (s.brk) {
      const apex = pos[1];
      const contact = [apex[0] - 2 * R, apex[1]];
      const next = { cue: null };
      const old = pos; pos = { cue: old.cue };
      for (let b = 1; b <= 15; b++) {
        if (s.pot.includes(b)) continue;
        const p = b <= 7 || b === 8 ? spot(['cue'], 380, 975, 25, 475) : spot(['cue'], 300, 975, 25, 475);
        pos[b] = p; next[b] = p;
      }
      s.pot.forEach(b => { ev.pockets[b] = 2; });
      const rest = spot([], 380, 520, 160, 340);
      ev.cuePath = [old.cue, round(contact), rest];
      pos.cue = rest;
      ev.potted = s.pot.slice(); ev.firstContact = 1;
    } else {
      const tgt = pos[s.target];
      const pk = nearest(tgt), pocket = P[pk];
      const dist = d(tgt, pocket) || 1;
      const dir = [(pocket[0] - tgt[0]) / dist, (pocket[1] - tgt[1]) / dist];
      let start = pos.cue;
      if (s.bih || !start) {
        start = round([tgt[0] - dir[0] * 140, tgt[1] - dir[1] * 140]);
        if (!free(start, ['cue'])) start = spot(['cue'], 60, 940, 40, 460);
      }
      const contact = round([tgt[0] - dir[0] * 2 * R, tgt[1] - dir[1] * 2 * R]);
      ev.firstContact = s.target;
      if (s.conf) ev.confidence.firstContact = s.conf;
      if (s.pot) { delete pos[s.target]; ev.potted.push(s.target); ev.pockets[s.target] = pk; }
      else {
        const move = Math.min(dist - 50, 70 + rnd() * 60);
        const np = round([tgt[0] + dir[0] * move, tgt[1] + dir[1] * move]);
        pos[s.target] = free(np, [String(s.target)]) ? np : tgt;
      }
      (s.extra || []).forEach(b => { if (pos[b]) { ev.pockets[b] = nearest(pos[b]); delete pos[b]; ev.potted.push(b); } });
      let rest;
      if (s.scratch) {
        const sp = P.map((q, i) => i).filter(i => i !== pk).sort((a, b) => d(contact, P[a]) - d(contact, P[b]))[0];
        rest = P[sp]; ev.cueBallPotted = true; delete pos.cue;
      } else {
        rest = null;
        for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !rest; i++) {
          const ang = (rnd() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * (0.6 + rnd() * 0.7);
          const len = 70 + rnd() * 160;
          const c = Math.cos(ang), sn = Math.sin(ang);
          const p = round([contact[0] + (dir[0] * c - dir[1] * sn) * len, contact[1] + (dir[0] * sn + dir[1] * c) * len]);
          if (free(p, ['cue'])) rest = p;
        }
        if (!rest) rest = spot(['cue'], 60, 940, 40, 460);
        pos.cue = rest;
      }
      ev.cuePath = [start, contact, round(rest)];
    }
    ev.positions = clone(pos);
    events.push(ev);
  });
  return events;
}

.cam-view .cam-tab:hover{border-color:var(--c-line3)}
.cam-view .cam-tab[aria-selected=true]{border-color:var(--c-brass);background:var(--c-board2);color:var(--c-chalk)}
.cam-view .cam-tab i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c-faint)}
.cam-view .cam-tab.watching i{background:var(--c-good)}.cam-view .cam-tab.motion i{background:var(--c-brass)}.cam-view .cam-tab.paused i{background:var(--c-foul)}.cam-view .cam-tab.calibrating i{background:var(--c-blue)}
.cam-view .cam-tab small{font:400 11.5px var(--c-mono);color:var(--c-faint);letter-spacing:.04em}
.cam-view .cam-add{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-left:auto}
.cam-view .cam-add select{width:auto;min-width:150px}
.cam-view .cam-col{display:grid;gap:18px;min-width:0}
.cam-view .cam-label{font:500 11px/1.3 var(--c-mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-dim)}
.cam-view .cam-sign{font-family:var(--c-sign);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.95}
.cam-view .cam-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:36px}

.cam-view .cam-pill::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c-faint)}
.cam-view .cam-pill.watching{color:var(--c-good)}.cam-view .cam-pill.watching::before{background:var(--c-good)}
.cam-view .cam-pill.motion{color:var(--c-brass);border-color:var(--c-brass)}.cam-view .cam-pill.motion::before{background:var(--c-brass)}
.cam-view .cam-pill.paused{color:var(--c-foul)}.cam-view .cam-pill.paused::before{background:var(--c-foul)}
.cam-view .cam-pill.calibrating{color:var(--c-bluetext)}.cam-view .cam-pill.calibrating::before{background:var(--c-blue)}
.cam-view .cam-meter{font:400 12px var(--c-mono);color:var(--c-faint)}
.cam-view .cam-top{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:36px}

.cam-view .cam-stage{position:relative;background:#050807;border:1px solid var(--c-line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/9}

.cam-view input[type=file]{padding:5px 12px 5px 5px;color:var(--c-dim)}

`;

  const esc = s => String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c]));
  const store = {
    get(k, d) { try { const v = localStorage.getItem('poolcam.' + k); return v == null ? d : JSON.parse(v); } catch (e) { return d; } },

  };

  const SHIELD = '<svg width="26" height="24" viewBox="0 0 26 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13 2.5 24 21.5H2Z" fill="none" stroke="#e5ad3e" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="13" cy="15" r="3.4" fill="#ecefe9"/></svg>';

  //   ctx = { id, base(), name(id), isRef(id), poll(), onState(state), onRemove(), canRemove() }
  function createUnit(host, ctx) {
    const tableId = () => ctx.id;

  </section>

    <div class="cam-card">

      <div class="cam-field" data-r="fileRow" style="display:none"><span class="cam-label">Video file</span>
        <input type="file" data-r="file" accept="video/*" aria-label="Video file"></div>
      <div class="cam-field"><span class="cam-label">Ball colours</span>
        <select data-r="balls" aria-label="Ball colours" title="The AI names balls by colour. Telling it this table's set makes it name the right ball far more often."><option value="standard">Usual colours (4 purple, 5 orange, 7 maroon)</option><option value="pink">4 pink, 5 purple, 7 orange</option></select></div>
      <div class="cam-btns"><button class="cam-b go" data-r="startBtn">Start</button><button class="cam-b" data-r="stopBtn" disabled>Stop</button><button class="cam-b" data-r="removeBtn" style="margin-left:auto" title="Stop this camera and take the table off this page">Remove table</button></div>

    host.appendChild(unit);
    const root = unit;
    const R = {}; root.querySelectorAll('[data-r]').forEach(n => { R[n.dataset.r] = n; });
    const v = R.v, ov = R.ov, octx = ov.getContext('2d');

    // ---------------- settings (remembered per table when storage works) ----------------
    const tableName = () => ctx.name(tableId());
    const NO_VENUE = 'Shot seen, but not scored: this demo page is not connected to a venue.';
    function renderConn() {
      R.title.textContent = tableName();
      const noRef = ctx.isRef(tableId()) === false ? ' While this camera is running, games that start on this table are refereed from its shots (they are not rated: only Table 1 is).' : '';

    renderConn();
    if (!base()) { R.now.textContent = 'A demo page has no live game to show.'; }
    R.src.value = store.get(key('src'), store.get('src', 'camera')) === 'file' ? 'file' : 'camera';

    R.balls.onchange = () => store.set(key('balls'), R.balls.value);

    // the camera is mounted once, looking straight down, and watches the whole picture with fixed levels: a shot starts when
    // more than 0.3% of the picture changes between two looks and ends after 1.5 s below 0.1%. Fixed levels caught 169 of 193

      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = a.width; c.height = a.height;
      const A = a.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, a.width, a.height).data, B = b.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, b.width, b.height).data;
      const g = c.getContext('2d'), out = g.createImageData(a.width, a.height);

          R.hint.className = 'cam-hint';

        }

      }
      if (paused) { draw(m); return; }

        sample(p.mids, MID_FRAMES).forEach((m, i) => fd.append('frame_mid_' + (i + 1), m.blob, m.t.toFixed(2) + '.jpg'));
        fd.append('frame_end', await toBlob(p.after), Math.max(0.01, p.dur).toFixed(2) + '.jpg');
        fd.append('frame_diff', await toBlob(diffCanvas(p.before, p.after)), 'diff.jpg');
        const res = await fetch(base() + '/pool-score', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
        const raw = await res.text(); let d;
        try { d = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { throw new Error(`Not scored: the venue's server gave an answer the camera could not read (code ${res.status}). Try the next shot; if it keeps happening, tell whoever runs the n8n workflow.`); }
        if (!d.ok) throw new Error('Not scored: ' + (d.error || d.message || 'the AI referee could not read this shot.') + (d.raw ? ' · AI said: ' + String(d.raw).slice(0, 160) : ''));
        updateLog(p.li, { status: 'done', data: d, secs: Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000) });

      } catch (e) {
        updateLog(p.li, { status: 'error', text: /fetch|load failed|network/i.test(e.message) ? 'Not scored: the venue\'s server did not answer. Check the internet connection and that the n8n workflow is switched on.' : e.message });

    // ---------------- UI: shot log ----------------
    const ringColor = s => s >= 85 ? COL.good : s >= 70 ? COL.lime : s >= 50 ? COL.brass : COL.foul;

      const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });

        li.innerHTML = `<div class="cam-ring" style="--p:${sc};--c:${ringColor(sc)}"><span>${sc}</span></div>

      ${d.tip ? `<div class="tip">Tip: ${esc(d.tip)}</div>` : ''}
      ${d.observations ? `<div class="mut">${esc(d.observations)}</div>` : ''}</div>`;
      } else {
        const icon = { queued: '…', sending: 'AI', ignored: '·', error: '!' }[o.status] || '';
        const cls = o.status === 'error' ? 'errtxt' : o.status === 'ignored' ? 'mut' : '';
        li.innerHTML = `<div class="cam-ring" style="--p:${o.status === 'error' ? 100 : 0};--c:${o.status === 'error' ? COL.foul : 'var(--c-line3)'}"><span style="font-size:16px">${icon}</span></div>

    // ---------------- UI: "Table now" (our GET {base}/pool?action=state) ----------------
    const GROUP_BALLS = { solids: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], stripes: [9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15] };
    function renderNow(j) {
      const t = (j.tables || []).find(x => x.id === tableId());

      const g = t.game;

      if (g.mode !== 'camera') {

        R.now.textContent = `${t.champ ? t.champ.name : 'Player 1'} vs ${t.challenger ? t.challenger.name : 'Player 2'}. This game started before the camera was on, so its shots are scored as practice. The next game on this table is refereed.`;

      }

      const left = s => {
