          if (!grp) return 'open table';
          const n = (g.onTable || []).filter(b => (GROUP_BALLS[grp] || []).includes(b)).length;
          return `${grp} · ${n} left`;
        }
        return '';
      };
      const players = ['champ', 'challenger'].map(s => `<div class="cam-pc ${g.turn === s ? 'on' : ''}"><b>${esc(seat(s))}</b><span>${esc(left(s) || (t[s] && t[s].rating ? 'rating ' + t[s].rating : ''))}</span></div>`).join('');
      const shots = (g.shots || []).length ? g.shots[g.shots.length - 1].no : 0;
      const head = `<div class="cam-now-game">${esc(t.gameType || '')}${shots ? ' · shot ' + shots : ''}</div>`;
      let body;
      if (g.status === 'confirm' || g.winner) {
        body = `<div class="cam-turn">${esc(seat(g.winner))} won</div><div class="cam-none">${esc(g.winReason || '')}${g.status === 'confirm' ? ' · Waiting for both players to confirm.' : ''}</div>`;
      } else if (g.turn) {
        body = `<div class="cam-turn">${esc(seat(g.turn))} to shoot${g.ballInHand ? '<small>BALL IN HAND</small>' : ''}</div>${g.status === 'review' || g.status === 'staff' ? '<div class="cam-none">A foul call is being reviewed.</div>' : ''}`;
      } else {
        body = `<div class="cam-none">Game running. No shots recorded yet.</div>`;
      }
      R.now.innerHTML = `${head}${body}<div class="cam-players" style="margin-top:12px">${players}</div>`;
    }

    // ---------------- overlay ----------------
    function draw(m) {
      const r = ov.getBoundingClientRect(); if (ov.width !== Math.round(r.width) || ov.height !== Math.round(r.height)) { ov.width = Math.round(r.width); ov.height = Math.round(r.height); }
      const W = ov.width, H = ov.height; octx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      if (m !== undefined && running) {
        const bw = Math.min(260, W - 24), lvl = Math.min(1, m / (ON * 2.5));
        octx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.6)'; octx.fillRect(12, H - 30, bw, 14);
        octx.fillStyle = m > ON ? COL.brass : COL.good; octx.fillRect(12, H - 30, bw * lvl, 14);
        octx.fillStyle = '#fff'; octx.fillRect(12 + bw * (1 / 2.5), H - 33, 2, 20);
        R.meter.textContent = `movement ${(m * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
      }
    }
    const onResize = () => draw();
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

    // ---------------- start / stop ----------------
    async function listDevices() {
      try {
        const devs = (await navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices()).filter(d => d.kind === 'videoinput'), cur = R.dev.value || wantDev;
        R.dev.innerHTML = '<option value="">Back camera (usual choice)</option>' + devs.map((d, i) => `<option value="${esc(d.deviceId)}">${esc(d.label || 'Camera ' + (i + 1))}</option>`).join('');
        R.dev.value = cur; if (R.dev.value !== cur) R.dev.value = '';
      } catch (e) { /* no device list */ }
    }
    function stopAll() {
      running = false; clearInterval(timer); setState('stopped');
      if (v.srcObject) { v.srcObject.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); v.srcObject = null; }
      v.pause(); R.startBtn.disabled = false; R.stopBtn.disabled = true; R.pauseBtn.disabled = true; R.manualBtn.disabled = true;
    }
    async function start() {
      R.setupErr.textContent = '';
      stopAll();
      try {
        if (R.src.value === 'camera') {
          if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) throw new Error('This browser will not share the camera with this page. Open the page from an https:// link, or pick "A recorded video" above.');
          const id = R.dev.value;
          const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: false, video: id ? { deviceId: { exact: id }, width: { ideal: 1920 }, height: { ideal: 1080 } } : { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 1920 }, height: { ideal: 1080 } } });
          v.srcObject = stream; await v.play(); listDevices();
        } else {
          const f = R.file.files[0]; if (!f) throw new Error('Choose a video file first.');
          v.removeAttribute('srcObject'); v.srcObject = null; v.src = URL.createObjectURL(f); v.loop = false; await v.play();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        const what = e.name + ' ' + e.message, fromCam = R.src.value === 'camera';
        R.setupErr.textContent = /Choose a video|will not share/.test(e.message) ? e.message
          : fromCam && /NotAllowed|Permission|denied/i.test(what) ? 'The camera is blocked for this page. Allow it in the browser\'s address bar, then press Start again.'
          : fromCam ? 'No camera could be started on this device. Check one is plugged in and not used by another app, or pick "A recorded video" above.'
          : 'This browser cannot play that video. Try an MP4 or WebM file.';
        return;
      }
      R.stage.classList.add('live');
      running = true; paused = false; prev = null; still = null; lastFrameT = -1;
      startCalibration(); timer = setInterval(tick, TICK_MS);
      R.startBtn.disabled = true; R.stopBtn.disabled = false; R.pauseBtn.disabled = false; R.manualBtn.disabled = false; R.pauseBtn.textContent = 'Pause';
      ctx.poll();
    }
    v.onended = () => { setTimeout(() => { if (running && state !== 'motion') { addLog({ status: 'ignored', text: 'The video has finished. Press Start to play it again.' }); stopAll(); } }, STILL_MS + 1200); };
    R.startBtn.onclick = start;
    R.stopBtn.onclick = stopAll;
    R.pauseBtn.onclick = () => { paused = !paused; R.pauseBtn.textContent = paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause'; if (paused) setState('paused'); else resetRef(); };
    R.manualBtn.onclick = scoreNow;
    if (R.src.value === 'camera') listDevices();
    setState('stopped');
    draw();

    return {
      id: ctx.id,
      el: unit,
      renderNow,
      refresh: renderConn,
      running: () => running,
      stop: () => stopAll(),
      show(on) { unit.hidden = !on; if (on) requestAnimationFrame(() => draw()); },
      destroy() { destroyed = true; stopAll(); window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize); unit.remove(); },
    };
  }

  // The camera page: a tab per table this device watches, an "Add a table" picker, and one shared poll of the venue.
  function mount(el, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const base = () => String(opts.base || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/\/(pool-[a-z]+)$/, '');
    const norm = id => String(id || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!document.getElementById('cam-view-style')) {
      const st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'cam-view-style'; st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st);
    }
    el.innerHTML = `
<div class="cam-view">
  <div class="cam-top"><h2 class="cam-sign">Table camera</h2>
    <div class="cam-brand">${opts.back ? `<a href="${esc(opts.back.href)}">${esc(opts.back.label)}</a>` : ''}<span>${SHIELD}LOOPOOL</span></div></div>
  <div class="cam-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Tables on this camera page">
    <span data-r="tabs" style="display:contents"></span>
    <div class="cam-add" data-r="addRow"><select data-r="addSel" aria-label="Table to add"></select><button class="cam-b" data-r="addBtn" title="Watch another table from this device, for example with a second webcam">Add table</button></div>
  </div>
  <div data-r="units" style="display:contents"></div>
</div>`;
    const root = el.querySelector('.cam-view');
    const R = {}; root.querySelectorAll('[data-r]').forEach(n => { R[n.dataset.r] = n; });

    // the venue's tables: from the live state when connected, else from the app (demo), else Tables 1-4
    let venue = null;
    const fallback = ['T1', 'T2', 'T3', 'T4'].map((id, i) => ({ id, name: 'Table ' + (i + 1), ref: id === 'T1' }));
    const known = () => {
      const live = venue && venue.tables, app = typeof opts.tables === 'function' ? opts.tables() : opts.tables;
      const list = (live && live.length ? live : app && app.length ? app : fallback).map(t => ({ id: norm(t.id), name: t.name || norm(t.id).replace(/^T(\d+)$/, 'Table $1'), ref: t.ref }));
      return list;
    };
    const info = id => known().find(t => t.id === id);
    const nameOf = id => (info(id) || {}).name || id.replace(/^T(\d+)$/, 'Table $1');
    const isRef = id => { const t = info(id); return t && typeof t.ref === 'boolean' ? t.ref : null; };

    const units = new Map(), tabs = new Map();
    let active = null, destroyed = false;
    const saveList = () => store.set('tables', [...units.keys()]);

    function select(id) {
      active = id;
      units.forEach((u, k) => u.show(k === id));
      tabs.forEach((b, k) => b.setAttribute('aria-selected', k === id ? 'true' : 'false'));
      store.set('active', id);
    }
    function renderAdd() {
      const free = known().filter(t => !units.has(t.id));
      R.addSel.innerHTML = free.map(t => `<option value="${esc(t.id)}">${esc(t.name)}${t.ref === false ? ' (not rated)' : ''}</option>`).join('');
      R.addRow.style.display = free.length ? '' : 'none';
    }
    function refreshAll() {
      tabs.forEach((b, id) => { b.querySelector('b').textContent = nameOf(id); });
      units.forEach(u => u.refresh());
      renderAdd();
    }
    function addTable(id, focus) {
      id = norm(id); if (!id || units.has(id)) { if (focus) select(id); return; }
      const tab = document.createElement('button');
      tab.className = 'cam-tab'; tab.type = 'button'; tab.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
      tab.innerHTML = '<i></i><b></b><small>Stopped</small>';
      tab.querySelector('b').textContent = nameOf(id);
      tab.onclick = () => select(id);
      R.tabs.appendChild(tab); tabs.set(id, tab);
      const u = createUnit(R.units, {
        id, base, name: nameOf, isRef,
        poll: () => pollState(),
        canRemove: () => units.size > 1,
        onRemove: () => removeTable(id),
        onState: (s, label) => { tab.className = 'cam-tab ' + (PILL_CLASS[s] || ''); tab.querySelector('small').textContent = label; },
      });
      units.set(id, u); saveList(); refreshAll();
      if (venue) u.renderNow(venue);
      if (focus || !active) select(id); else u.show(false);
    }
    function removeTable(id) {
      const u = units.get(id); if (!u || units.size < 2) return;
      if (u.running() && !confirm(nameOf(id) + ' is still watching. Stop its camera and remove it from this page?')) return;
      u.destroy(); units.delete(id); tabs.get(id).remove(); tabs.delete(id); saveList();
      if (active === id) select(units.keys().next().value);
      refreshAll();
    }
    R.addBtn.onclick = () => { if (R.addSel.value) addTable(R.addSel.value, true); };

    // ---------------- one poll of GET {base}/pool?action=state for every table on the page ----------------
    let pollBusy = false;
    async function pollState() {
      if (destroyed || !base() || pollBusy) return;
      pollBusy = true;
      try {
        // name the tables whose camera is running, so the venue referees their games (see camOn in the engine)
        const cams = [...units.values()].filter(u => u.running()).map(u => u.id).join(',');
        const r = await fetch(`${base()}/pool?action=state${cams ? '&cams=' + encodeURIComponent(cams) : ''}`, { cache: 'no-store' }); const d = await r.json();
        if (d && d.ok !== false && d.tables) {
          const before = JSON.stringify(known());
          venue = d; units.forEach(u => u.renderNow(d));
          if (JSON.stringify(known()) !== before) refreshAll();
        }
      } catch (e) { /* keep the last picture of the tables */ }
      pollBusy = false;
    }
    const pollTimer = setInterval(pollState, POLL_MS);

    const saved = store.get('tables', null);
    const start = (Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length ? saved : [opts.table || 'T1']).map(norm).filter(Boolean);
    [...new Set(start)].forEach(id => addTable(id, false));
    const want = norm(store.get('active', ''));
    select(units.has(want) ? want : units.keys().next().value);
    pollState();

    return {
      addTable: id => addTable(id, true),
      running: () => [...units.values()].filter(u => u.running()).map(u => u.id),   // tables whose camera is on (bar app)
      stopAll() { units.forEach(u => { if (u.running()) u.stop(); }); },              // the bar ended the session
      destroy() { destroyed = true; clearInterval(pollTimer); units.forEach(u => u.destroy()); units.clear(); el.innerHTML = ''; },
    };
  }

  window.CameraView = { mount };
})();

// (its name and key facts, events, Start a game) -> start a game by hand, or with the camera -> camera set-up ->
// the bar TV view (stays on until staff press Exit) -> back to the home page. The profile menu edits the bar
// (with everything already filled in), switches to the player app, or deletes the bar.
// The profile, sessions and events are saved by the same Referee engine as the queue (venue_save, venue_open,
// venue_delete, event_*), so in live mode n8n stores them and every screen sees them.
// This file only uses the page helpers ($, esc, act, toast, S) inside functions, so it can load before app.js.
var BIZ = { dirty: false, editId: null, sig: {} };
var BAPP = { screen: 'home', camFrom: 'start', editing: false, cam: null, lastOpen: null, formOpen: false, sig: {} };
var BIZ_DAYS = [['mon', 'Monday'], ['tue', 'Tuesday'], ['wed', 'Wednesday'], ['thu', 'Thursday'], ['fri', 'Friday'], ['sat', 'Saturday'], ['sun', 'Sunday']];
var BIZ_KINDS = { tournament: 'Tournament', league: 'League night', social: 'Social night', lesson: 'Lesson or coaching' };

function bizTime(t) {                                        // "19:30" -> "7:30 PM"
  const m = /^(\d\d):(\d\d)$/.exec(t || ''); if (!m) return '';
  const h = Number(m[1]), ap = h < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM', h12 = h % 12 || 12;
  return h12 + (m[2] === '00' ? '' : ':' + m[2]) + ' ' + ap;
}
function bizDay(iso) {                                       // "2026-11-17" -> "Tue 17 Nov"
  const d = new Date(iso + 'T12:00:00'); if (isNaN(d)) return iso;
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }).replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '');
}
function bizToday(v, now) {                                  // "Open today 4 PM – 2 AM" from the weekly hours
  if (!v || !v.hours) return '';
  const h = v.hours[BIZ_DAYS[(new Date(now).getDay() + 6) % 7][0]];
  if (!h) return '';
  return h.closed ? 'Closed today' : 'Open today ' + bizTime(h.open) + ' – ' + bizTime(h.close);
}

// Auto-fill: n8n opens the link and reads the page (see "Bar profile auto-fill" in the workflow). The demo page has
// no n8n behind it, so it fills in an example to show the idea.
async function bizAutofill() {
  const url = $('#afUrl').value.trim(), st = $('#afStatus'), btn = $('#afBtn');
  if (!url) return toast('Paste your Google Maps or website link first.');
  btn.disabled = true; st.textContent = 'Reading your page… this takes about 10 seconds.';
  let res;
  try {
    if (S.mode === 'live') { const r = await fetch(S.base.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/pool-lookup?url=' + encodeURIComponent(url), { cache: 'no-store' }); res = await r.json(); }
    else {
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900));
      const H = {}; BIZ_DAYS.forEach(([d]) => { H[d] = { open: d === 'sat' || d === 'sun' ? '12:00' : '16:00', close: d === 'fri' || d === 'sat' ? '02:00' : '00:00', closed: d === 'mon' }; });
      res = { ok: true, demo: true, profile: Object.assign({ name: 'The Corner Pocket', about: 'Six tables, cheap pints and a camera referee on Table 1.', address: '12 Water St, Vancouver, BC', phone: '+1 604-555-0199', tableCount: 6, tableBrand: 'Diamond', tableSize: '8 ft', cues: 20, hours: H, lat: 49.2843, lng: -123.1086 }, /maps|goo\.gl/.test(url) ? { mapsUrl: url } : { website: /^https:\/\//.test(url) ? url : '' }) };
    }
  } catch (e) { res = { ok: false, error: 'Couldn’t reach n8n to read the page. Fill the profile in yourself.' }; }
  btn.disabled = false;
  if (!res || !res.ok) { st.textContent = (res && res.error) || 'We couldn’t read that page. Fill the profile in yourself.'; return; }
  const f = $('#bizProfile'), p = res.profile || {}; let n = 0;
  ['name', 'about', 'address', 'mapsUrl', 'phone', 'website', 'tableCount', 'tableBrand', 'tableSize', 'cues'].forEach(k => { if (p[k] != null && p[k] !== '' && f.elements[k]) { f.elements[k].value = p[k]; f.elements[k].classList.add('filled'); n++; } });
  if (p.lat != null && p.lng != null) { f.elements.lat.value = p.lat; f.elements.lng.value = p.lng; }
  if (p.hours) { BIZ_DAYS.forEach(([d]) => { const h = p.hours[d]; if (!h) return; f.elements['h-' + d + '-open'].value = h.open || ''; f.elements['h-' + d + '-close'].value = h.close || ''; f.elements['h-' + d + '-closed'].checked = !!h.closed; }); n++; }
  BIZ.dirty = true;
  st.textContent = (res.demo ? 'Demo: filled in with an example bar. Connected to n8n, it reads your real page. ' : '') + 'Filled in ' + n + ' field' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + '. Check them, add anything missing, then save.';
}

// ---------- which app the address asks for ----------
function shellRoute(h) {
  document.body.classList.toggle('served', servedByN8n);

}
function shellView(h) {

// ---------- the player's profile: name + email, kept on this phone; a password once they've played a game ----------
function playerProfile() { return store.get('player', null) || PAPP.mem || null; }
function savePlayerProfile(p) { PAPP.mem = p; store.set('player', p); }
function favs() { return store.get('favs', null) || PAPP.favMem || []; }
function setFavs(list) { PAPP.favMem = list; store.set('favs', list); }
const validEmail = e => /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(e);
async function hashPassword(email, pw) {           // the password never leaves the phone; n8n stores this hash
  const text = 'loopool|' + email.trim().toLowerCase() + '|' + pw;
  try { const d = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(text)); return Array.from(new Uint8Array(d)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); }
  catch (e) { let h = 2166136261, out = ''; for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) { for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { h ^= text.charCodeAt(i) + r; h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); } out += (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0'); } return out + out; }
}
function needsAccount(st) { const P = playerProfile(); return !!(P && !P.account && st.my && (st.my.w + st.my.l) >= 1); }

// ---------- bars, distance and the wait ----------
function bars(st) {
  const v = st.venue || {};
  const list = v.setup ? [Object.assign({}, v, { id: 'home', home: true, events: st.events || [] })] : [];
  return list.concat(st.directory || []);
}
function mapsLink(b) { return b.mapsUrl || 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=' + encodeURIComponent([b.name, b.address].filter(Boolean).join(' ')); }
function distKm(b) {
  if (!PAPP.geo || b.lat == null || b.lng == null) return null;
  const R = 6371, rad = x => x * Math.PI / 180, dLat = rad(b.lat - PAPP.geo.lat), dLng = rad(b.lng - PAPP.geo.lng);
  const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(rad(PAPP.geo.lat)) * Math.cos(rad(b.lat)) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
  return 2 * R * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(a));
}
function distText(b) { const d = distKm(b); return d == null ? '' : d < 1 ? Math.round(d * 1000 / 10) * 10 + ' m away' : (d < 10 ? d.toFixed(1) : Math.round(d)) + ' km away'; }
function askLocation() {
  if (PAPP.geoAsked || !navigator.geolocation) return; PAPP.geoAsked = true;
  navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(p => { PAPP.geo = { lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }; PAPP.sig = {}; render(); }, () => { /* no location: no distances */ }, { timeout: 8000, maximumAge: 600000 });
}
function waitText(st) {                                       // a rough wait for someone joining now, from the live board
  const free = st.tables.filter(t => t.status === 'empty' || (t.status === 'waiting' && !t.challenger)).length;
  if (free && !st.queue.length) return 'A table is free now';
  const lefts = st.tables.map(t => t.game && t.game.left).filter(x => x != null);
  const soonest = lefts.length ? Math.min(...lefts) : 12;
  const min = Math.max(1, Math.round(soonest + Math.floor(st.queue.length / Math.max(1, st.tables.length)) * 13));
  return 'About ' + min + ' min wait · ' + st.queue.length + ' in line';
}
function barTodayLine(b, st) { if (b.home && b.open === false) return 'Closed right now'; return bizToday(b, st.now) || ''; }

async function doJoin(o) {

  S.ticket = null;
  const r = await act('join', { name: P.name, email: P.email, hash: P.hash || undefined, gameType: o.gameType || '8-ball', refOnly: !!o.refOnly && (o.gameType || '8-ball') === '8-ball' }, true);
  if (!r || !r.ok) {
    if (r && r.code === 401) { PAPP.acct = { then: 'join' }; PAPP.acctJoin = o; PAPP.login = true; PAPP.tab = 'home'; PAPP.sig = {}; render(); return; }
    toast((r && r.error) || 'Couldn’t join right now. Try again.'); return;
  }
  PAPP.tab = 'home'; PAPP.bar = null; PAPP.joinFor = null; PAPP.invite = null; PAPP.sig = {}; S.sigs.clear();
  toast(r.me && r.me.position ? 'You’re #' + r.me.position + ' in line.' : 'You’re on the board.');
  render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}

function bindJoin(el) {
  const f = $('#joinForm', el); if (!f) return;
  f.addEventListener('input', () => { S.draft.name = $('#jName', f).value; S.draft.email = $('#jEmail', f).value; S.draft.refOnly = $('#jRef', f).checked; });
  $$('[data-game]', f).forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => { S.draft.gameType = b.dataset.game; S.sigs.delete(el); render(); }));
  f.addEventListener('submit', async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!S.draft.name.trim()) { toast('Add your name first.'); return; }
    const r = await act('join', { name: S.draft.name, email: S.draft.email, gameType: S.draft.gameType, refOnly: S.draft.refOnly && S.draft.gameType === '8-ball' });
    if (r && r.ok) { S.joinOpen = false; toast('You\'re on the board. Ticket ' + r.me.ticket); }

// ---------- bar TV ----------
// The TV is laid out once, on a 16:9 canvas (1280 x 720), and scaled to the screen the way signage is: the whole screen
// at #tv, the column width on the Bar TV tab. Columns too narrow for that (All screens, phones) keep the stacked layout.
const TV_W = 1280, TV_H = 720;
function fitTV(el) {
  const full = document.body.classList.contains('tvmode');
  const w = full ? window.innerWidth : el.clientWidth;
  const fit = w >= (full ? 900 : 1100);
  el.classList.toggle('tvfit', fit);
  if (full) document.body.classList.toggle('tvfull', fit);
  if (fit) el.style.setProperty('--tvz', Math.floor((full ? Math.min(w / TV_W, window.innerHeight / TV_H) : w / TV_W) * 10000) / 10000);
}
// Right column, under the queue: the last shot when the AI has scored it from the camera photos (the call, the 0-100
// score and the tip; the after-photo is the big picture beside it), tonight's results otherwise.
function tvShotHTML(s) {
  const col = scoreColor(s.score);
  return `<section class="shotcard" aria-label="Last shot"><span class="label">Last shot · shot ${s.no}</span>
    <div class="sc"><b class="ring" style="color:${col}" aria-label="Score ${s.score} out of 100">${s.score}</b><p>${s.grade ? `<strong style="color:${col}">${esc(s.grade)}</strong> ` : ''}${shotLine(s, true)}.</p></div>
    ${s.tip ? `<p class="tipline">Tip for ${esc(s.shooter)}: ${esc(s.tip)}</p>` : ''}</section>`;
}
function tvResultsHTML(st) {
  const rows = st.recent.slice(0, 3);

' · +' + r.delta + ' rating' : ''}</small></div>`).join('')}</div>` : '<p class="dim">No games finished yet tonight.</p>'}</section>`;
}
function renderTV(el, st, key) {
  fitTV(el);

  const feed = st.feed.slice(0, 5), top = st.leaderboard.slice(0, 6);
  const sig = JSON.stringify([t.id, t.frameAt, t.gameType, t.status, t.streak, !g && t.game && t.game.minutes, t.champ && [t.champ.name, t.champ.rating], t.challenger && [t.challenger.name, t.challenger.present], g && [g.id, g.shots.length, g.status, g.turn, g.review && [g.review.staff, g.review.votes], g.shots[g.shots.length - 1]], st.queue.map(q => q.ticket + q.status + (q.eta && q.eta.min)), top.map(p => p.name + p.rating), st.leaderboard.map(p => p.badges), st.recent.slice(0, 3).map(r => r.at), feed.map(f => f.at + f.text), S.qr ? 1 : 0, st.me && st.me.ticket]);
  if (S.sigs.get(el) === sig) return;
  S.sigs.set(el, sig);
  let board = '', banner = '', idle = '';
  if (g) {
    const pl = (side, right) => {
      const grp = g.groups[side], potted = groupBalls(grp).filter(b => !g.onTable.includes(b));
      const meta = [t[side].rating, grp || 'open table', side === 'champ' && t.streak ? t.streak + ' win' + (t.streak > 1 ? 's' : '') : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      const name = `<span class="chalk">${right ? `<small>${esc(meta)}</small> ` : ''}${esc(t[side].name)}${right ? '' : ` <small>${esc(meta)}</small>`}</span>`;
      return `<div class="p${right ? ' r' : ''}${g.turn === side ? ' turn' : ''}">${name}<div class="tray">${potted.length ? potted.map(ballChip).join('') : '<span class="open">—</span>'}</div></div>`;
    };
    board = `<div class="score">${pl('challenger')}<div class="mid">${g.shots.length ? 'SHOT<b class="num">' + g.shots.length + '</b>' : 'BREAK'}</div>${pl('champ', true)}</div>`;
    if (g.status === 'review') banner = `<div class="banner">${g.review.staff ? 'PLAYERS DISAGREE · STAFF DECIDING' : 'POSSIBLE FOUL · SHOT ' + g.review.shotNo + ' · PLAYERS DECIDING'}</div>`;

    if (ch) board = `<div class="score">${seat(nx)}<div class="mid">VS</div>${seat(ch, true)}</div>`;
    const head = t.game ? 'Camera starts with the next game' : nx ? 'Up next' : ch ? esc(t.name) + ' needs a player' : esc(t.name) + ' is open';
    const line = t.game ? esc(ch.name) + ' and ' + esc(nx.name) + ' are finishing a game (' + t.game.minutes + ' min in).' : nx ? (nx.present ? 'Both players are at the table.' : esc(nx.name) + ' is checking in.') : 'Scan the code to put your name on the board.';

  el.innerHTML = `<div class="tv"><div class="tv-top"><div class="t"><span class="onair">LIVE</span><span class="sign">${esc(t.name)} · ${g && g.rated ? 'Rated ' : ''}${esc(t.gameType)}</span></div><div class="mark" style="margin:0;min-height:0">${ICON.mark}<b>LOOPOOL</b></div></div>
    <div class="tv-grid"><div class="tv-main">${board}<div class="tvtable">${g && photoURL(t) ? photoHTML(t, 'Camera photo' + (g.shots.length ? ' · after shot ' + g.shots.length : '')) : '<div data-tbl="tv"></div>'}${banner}${idle}</div>
      <div class="ticker"><p class="now"><b class="${f && f.kind === 'ai' ? 'ai' : ''}">${f && f.kind === 'ai' ? 'AI CALL' : 'LATEST'}</b><span>${f ? esc(f.text) : 'Waiting for the first shot'}</span></p>${feed.length > 1 ? `<div class="older"><div>${feed.slice(1).map(x => `<p>${esc(x.text)}</p>`).join('')}</div></div>` : ''}</div></div>
      <div class="aside">
        ${boardHTML(st, { gameType: t.gameType, title: 'On the board · ' + t.gameType, eta: true, max: 4 })}
        ${last && last.score != null ? tvShotHTML(last) : tvResultsHTML(st)}
        <section aria-label="Tonight's ratings" class="ratings"><span class="label">Tonight's ratings</span><div class="rt">${top.map((p, i) => `<div><span class="rk">${i + 1}</span><span class="nm">${esc(p.name)}</span><span class="pts">${p.rating}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>${honours.length ? `<p class="honours">${honours.join('')}</p>` : ''}</section>
        <div class="qrline"><span class="qrbox">${S.qr ? `<img src="${S.qr}" alt="QR code to join the queue">` : ''}</span><span class="sign">Scan to put your name on the board</span></div>
      </div></div></div>`;
  const v = mount(el, 'tv@' + key); if (v) v.show(g, g && g.status === 'review' && g.review ? g.review.ball : null);
}

// ---------- counter tablet ----------
function renderVenue(el, st) {
  const sig = JSON.stringify([st.tables.map(t => [t.status, t.streak, t.champ && [t.champ.name, t.champ.rating], t.challenger && [t.challenger.name, t.challenger.present, liveLeft(t.challenger.checkinLeft)], t.game && [t.game.minutes, t.game.status, t.game.shots && t.game.shots.length]]), st.queue, st.recent.slice(0, 5).map(r => r.at), st.feed.slice(0, 10).map(f => f.at + f.text), S.qr ? 1 : 0, Math.floor(st.now / 60000)]);
  if (S.sigs.get(el) === sig) return;
  S.sigs.set(el, sig);
  const statusText = t => ({ playing: ['play', 'In play'], review: ['alert', 'Foul review'], staff: ['alert', 'Staff decision'], confirm: ['wait', 'Confirming result'], checkin: ['wait', 'Checking in'], waiting: ['wait', 'Needs a player'], empty: ['free', 'Free'] }[t.status] || ['free', t.status]);
  const seat = (t, side) => {
    const s = t[side]; if (!s) return '<div class="seat"><span class="dim">Open seat</span></div>';
    const right = !s.present ? 'checking in ' + mmss(liveLeft(s.checkinLeft)) : side === 'champ' && t.streak ? s.rating + ' · ' + t.streak + ' in a row' : String(s.rating);
    return `<div class="seat"><span class="chalk">${esc(s.name)}</span><small>${right}</small></div>`;
  };
  const cards = st.tables.map(t => {
    const g = t.game, [cls, txt] = statusText(t);
    let extra = '';
    if (g && g.status === 'review' && g.review) extra = g.review.staff
      ? `<p style="font-size:13.5px">Players disagree on shot ${g.review.shotNo}: ${esc(g.review.foul.text)}.</p><div class="decide"><button class="uphold" data-act="staff" data-t="${t.id}" data-v="uphold">Foul</button><button data-act="staff" data-t="${t.id}" data-v="overrule">No foul</button></div>`
      : `<p class="dim" style="font-size:13.5px">Players are reviewing shot ${g.review.shotNo}.</p>`;
    const meta = [t.gameType, t.ref || t.camera ? 'camera referee' : '', g ? (g.minutes ? g.minutes + ' min' : 'just started') : '', g && g.mode === 'camera' && g.shots.length ? 'shot ' + g.shots.length : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    return `<div class="tcard${t.status === 'staff' ? ' staff' : ''}"><div class="hd"><span class="sign">${esc(t.name)}</span><span class="st ${cls}">${txt}</span></div><span class="meta">${esc(meta)}</span><div class="felt"></div>${seat(t, 'champ')}${seat(t, 'challenger')}${extra}</div>`;
  }).join('');
  // Red is kept for what staff must act on: a foul the players disagree about, until staff decide it. Everything else is a plain record.
  const needsStaff = f => f.kind === 'staff' && st.tables.some(t => t.id === f.table && t.status === 'staff' && t.game && t.game.id === f.game && t.game.review && t.game.review.shotNo === f.shot);
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="tablet"><div class="tab-top"><span class="sign">${esc(st.venue.name)}</span><span class="clock num">${fmtTime(st.now)}</span></div>
    <div class="tgrid"><div class="panel" style="min-width:0"><div class="tables">${cards}</div>
      <section aria-label="Activity" class="panel" style="margin-top:6px"><span class="label">Activity</span><div class="activity">${st.feed.slice(0, 8).map(f => needsStaff(f) ? `<div class="todo"><span class="tm">${fmtTime(f.at)}</span><span>${ICON.flag}${esc(f.text)}</span></div>` : `<div><span class="tm">${fmtTime(f.at)}</span><span>${esc(f.text)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></section></div>
      <div class="panel" style="min-width:0;gap:16px">
        ${boardHTML(st, { title: 'The board · all games', eta: true })}
        <div class="qrline"><span class="qrbox">${S.qr ? `<img src="${S.qr}" alt="QR code to join the queue">` : ''}</span><span class="sign">Scan to put your name on the board</span></div>
        <section aria-label="Recent results" class="panel"><span class="label">Recent results</span><div class="results">${st.recent.slice(0, 5).map(r => `<div><span><b>${esc(r.winner)}</b> beat ${esc(r.loser)}</span><small>${esc(r.table)}${r.rated ? ' · +' + r.delta : ''}</small></div>`).join('')}</div></section>
      </div></div></div>`;
}

// ---------- shell ----------
function renderMode() {
  const b = $('#modeBtn');
  b.className = 'src' + (S.mode === 'live' ? (S.err ? ' err' : ' live') : '');
  b.textContent = S.mode === 'live' ? (S.err ? 'n8n unreachable' : 'Live from n8n') : 'Demo data';
}
function renderControls(st) {
  const me = st && st.me;
  const bar = document.querySelector('.controls'); if (bar) bar.style.display = servedByN8n ? 'none' : '';   // demo tools: never on a real venue's page
  $$('[data-act="quick"], [data-act="reset"]').forEach(b => { b.hidden = S.mode === 'live'; });   // demo data only
  $('[data-act="quick"]').disabled = !!(me && ['waiting', 'called', 'playing'].includes(me.status));
}
function render() {
  $$('.views a').forEach(a => { const on = a.dataset.view === S.view; a.classList.toggle('on', on); if (on) a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page'); else a.removeAttribute('aria-current'); });
  VIEWS.forEach(v => $('#v-' + v).classList.toggle('on', v === S.view));
  renderMode();
  const st = S.state; renderControls(st);
  if (!st) return;
  const v = S.view;
  if (v === 'player') renderPlayerApp(st);                 // player.js
  if (v === 'biz') renderBizApp(st);                       // business.js
  if (v === 'live') renderTV($('#v-live [data-tv]'), st, 'live');
}
// ---------- staff tools on the counter tablet (start match, switch turn, foul, undo, next match, winner, group, clear) ----------
function renderStaff(st) {
  const t = st.tables.find(x => x.id === $('#sTable').value) || st.tables[0], g = t.game;
  const names = [t.challenger, t.champ].filter(Boolean).map(s => s.name), sig = names.join('|');
  [$('#sWho'), $('#sWho2')].forEach(sel => { if (sel.dataset.sig !== sig) { sel.innerHTML = names.map(n => `<option>${esc(n)}</option>`).join('') || '<option value="">No players</option>'; sel.dataset.sig = sig; } });
  const cam = g && g.mode === 'camera', live = cam && g.status === 'live', type = (g && g.gameType) || t.gameType, eight = type === '8-ball';
  // each tool is switched off when it cannot do anything on this table, and the line beside the table name says why
  let now;
  if (!g) now = (t.champ ? t.champ.name + ' holds the table' + (t.challenger ? ', ' + t.challenger.name + ' is checking in' : ', waiting for a challenger') : 'Free') + '. No game to fix.';
  else if (!cam) now = type + ' · ' + g.minutes + ' min in · no camera here, so staff can only declare the winner or clear the table.';
  else now = type + ' · ' + (g.shots.length ? 'shot ' + g.shots.length : 'no shots yet') + ' · ' + (g.turn ? t[g.turn].name + ' to shoot' + (g.ballInHand ? ' (ball in hand)' : '') : g.status === 'confirm' ? 'game over, players are confirming the result' : 'paused for a foul review: decide it on the table card above');
  $('#sNow').textContent = now;
  $('#sSwitch').disabled = $('#sFoul').disabled = !live;
  $('#sGrp').disabled = $('#sWho2').disabled = $('#sGroup').disabled = !(live && eight);
  $('#sGrp').title = live && !eight ? 'Solids and stripes only exist in 8-ball' : '';
  $('#sEnd').disabled = $('#sWho').disabled = !g;
  $('#sNext').disabled = !!g;
  $('#sUndo').disabled = !t.canUndo;
  $('#sClear').disabled = !g && !t.champ && !t.challenger;
}
// An in-app "are you sure?" that matches the other dialogs. Resolves true only when the action button is pressed
// (Esc and the other button both mean no). The safe button gets the focus.
function askConfirm(o) {
  const d = $('#confirmDlg');
  if (!d.showModal) return Promise.resolve(window.confirm(o.title + '\n\n' + o.text));   // browsers without <dialog>
  $('#cfTitle').textContent = o.title; $('#cfText').textContent = o.text;
  $('#cfNo').textContent = o.no; $('#cfYes').textContent = o.yes;
  d.returnValue = '';
  return new Promise(done => { d.addEventListener('close', () => done(d.returnValue === 'yes'), { once: true }); d.showModal(); $('#cfNo').focus(); });
}
async function staffAct(a) {
  const table = $('#sTable').value, tname = $('#sTable').selectedOptions[0].textContent.replace(/ \(.*$/, '');
  const t0 = S.state && S.state.tables.find(x => x.id === table), g0 = t0 && t0.game;
  const at0 = t0 ? [t0.challenger, t0.champ].filter(Boolean).map(x => x.name) : [];
  if (a === 'start') {
    const p1 = $('#sP1').value.trim(), p2 = $('#sP2').value.trim();
    if (!p1 || !p2) return toast('Type both player names first.');
    const params = { table, players: p1 + ',' + p2, gameType: $('#sGame').value };
    const replace = () => askConfirm({ title: 'Replace the game on ' + tname + '?', text: (at0.length === 2 ? at0.join(' and ') + ' are playing on ' + tname : 'A game is being played on ' + tname) + '. Starting ' + p1 + ' vs ' + p2 + ' ends that game with no winner. Undo last change brings it back.', yes: 'Start the new match', no: 'Keep the game' });
    if (g0 && g0.status !== 'confirm') { if (!await replace()) return; params.force = '1'; }
    let r = await act('start_match', params, true);
    if (r && !r.ok && r.code === 409 && !params.force) { if (!await replace()) return; params.force = '1'; r = await act('start_match', params, true); }   // a game started there after this screen last refreshed
    if (r && !r.ok) toast(r.error);
    if (r && r.ok) { $('#sP1').value = ''; $('#sP2').value = ''; toast(p1 + ' vs ' + p2 + ' started on ' + tname + '. ' + p1 + ' breaks.'); }
    return;
  }
  if (a === 'end') { const w = $('#sWho').value; if (!w) return toast('No players at this table.'); const r = await act('end_match', { table, winner: w }); if (r && r.ok) toast(w + ' wins on ' + tname + '.'); return; }
  if (a === 'group') { const w = $('#sWho2').value, grp = $('#sGroup').value; const r = await act('set_group', { table, player: w, group: grp }); if (r && r.ok) toast(w + ' now plays ' + grp + '.'); return; }
  if (a === 'reset_table' && !await askConfirm({ title: 'Clear ' + tname + '?', text: (g0 ? (at0.length === 2 ? at0.join(' and ') + '\u2019s game' : 'The game') + ' stops with no winner' : at0.join(' and ') + (at0.length === 1 ? ' leaves' : ' leave') + ' the table') + ', and the next people in the queue are called to ' + tname + '. Undo last change brings it back.', yes: 'Clear table', no: g0 ? 'Keep the game' : 'Leave it as it is' })) return;
  const r = await act(a, { table });
  if (!r || !r.ok) return;
  const t = r.tables.find(x => x.id === table), g = t && t.game, turn = g && g.turn && t[g.turn] ? t[g.turn].name : '';
  toast({ switch_turn: turn ? 'Turn switched: ' + turn + ' to shoot.' : 'Turn switched.', foul: turn ? 'Foul called. ' + turn + ' has ball in hand.' : 'Foul called.', undo: 'Last change on ' + tname + ' undone.', next_match: 'Next players called to ' + tname + '.', reset_table: tname + ' cleared.' }[a] || 'Done.');
}
// #tv = the bar TV on its own, full screen; #mobile = the player phone on its own. Neither shows the site header,
// the test buttons (Reset!) or the footer, so the QR code and emails link to #mobile.
function route() { const h0 = hashParts().view; document.body.classList.toggle('kiosk', h0 === 'tv'); document.body.classList.toggle('tvmode', h0 === 'tv'); if (h0 !== 'tv') document.body.classList.remove('tvfull'); S.view = shellRoute(h0); render(); }   // shell.js maps the address to an app

async function sendShot(silent) {
  const st = S.state, t = st && cameraTable(st), g = t && t.game;
  if (!g) { if (!silent) toast('No camera game yet. Press Quick start, or join and check in at Table 1.'); return; }
  if (g.status === 'review') { if (!silent) toast('Play is paused for the foul review. Decide on the phone.'); return; }
  if (g.status !== 'live') { if (!silent) toast('This game is over.'); return; }
  const ev = SCRIPT[g.shots.length];
  if (!ev) { if (!silent) toast('The recorded game has no more shots.'); return; }
  S.lastEv = ev; $('#evPre').textContent = JSON.stringify(ev, null, 2);
  await act('shot', { table: t.id, event: JSON.stringify(ev) });
}
async function quickStart() {
  const r = await act('join', { name: S.draft.name || 'Alex', email: S.draft.email, gameType: '8-ball', refOnly: true });
  if (!r || !r.ok) return;
  await act('skip'); const c = await act('checkin');
  if (c && c.ok) { S.auto = true; toast('You\'re at Table 1 against the table holder. Shots play automatically.'); renderControls(S.state); }
}

document.addEventListener('click', async e => {
  const a = e.target.closest('[data-act]'); if (!a || a.disabled) return;
  const x = a.dataset.act;
  if (x === 'openjoin') { S.joinOpen = true; if (S.state && S.state.me && S.state.me.status === 'left') S.ticket = null; S.sigs.clear(); render(); }
  else if (x === 'closejoin') { S.joinOpen = false; S.sigs.clear(); render(); }
  else if (x === 'leave') act('leave');
  else if (x === 'checkin') act('checkin');
  else if (x === 'flag') act('flag');
  else if (x === 'vote') act('vote', { vote: a.dataset.v });
  else if (x === 'confirm') act('confirm');
  else if (x === 'report') act('report', { result: a.dataset.v });
  else if (x === 'staff') act('staff', { table: a.dataset.t, decision: a.dataset.v });
  else if (x === 'ack') { S.ack[a.dataset.g] = true; render(); }
  else if (x === 'rejoin') playerRejoin();   // player.js: same name and email, and the password once there's an account
  else if (x === 'done') { S.ticket = null; S.joinOpen = false; if (S.mode === 'live') saveTicket(null); S.sigs.clear(); act('state'); }
  else if (x === 'ask') { const d = $('#askDlg'); if (d.showModal) { d.showModal(); setTimeout(() => $('#askInput').focus(), 50); } }
  else if (x === 'askclose') $('#askDlg').close();
  else if (x.startsWith('s-')) staffAct(x.slice(2));
  else if (x === 'quick') quickStart();
  else if (x === 'skip1') act('advance', { minutes: 1 });
  else if (x === 'skipturn') act('skip');
  else if (x === 'shot') sendShot();
  else if (x === 'auto') { S.auto = !S.auto; renderControls(S.state); if (S.auto) sendShot(true); }
  else if (x === 'reset') { S.auto = false; S.ack = {}; S.lastEv = null; S.ticket = null; S.joinOpen = false; S.sigs.clear(); S.tviews.forEach(v => { v.stop(); v.key = null; }); await act('reset'); toast('Demo reset'); }
  else if (x === 'showev') { const d = $('#evDlg'); if (d.showModal) d.showModal(); }
  else if (x === 'settings') { $('#baseInput').value = S.base || 'http://localhost:5678/webhook'; $('#testRes').textContent = ''; const d = $('#settings'); if (d.showModal) d.showModal(); }
  else if (x === 'use-demo') { S.mode = 'demo'; S.err = null; S.ticket = null; store.set('mode', 'demo'); $('#settings').close(); S.sigs.clear(); await act('state'); toast('Using demo data in this browser'); }
  else if (x === 'connect') {
    const v = $('#baseInput').value.trim(), res = $('#testRes');
    try { new URL(v); } catch (err) { res.textContent = 'That isn\'t a full URL. It should start with http:// or https://'; return; }
    const prev = { mode: S.mode, base: S.base };
    S.mode = 'live'; S.base = v; res.textContent = 'Testing…';
    const r = await api('state');
    if (r) { store.set('mode', 'live'); store.set('base', v); S.ticket = loadTicket(); S.sigs.clear(); res.textContent = 'Connected.'; setTimeout(() => $('#settings').close(), 400); apply(r, true); toast('Connected to n8n'); }
    else { res.textContent = 'Couldn\'t reach n8n (' + S.err + '). Check the workflow is active. A published demo page can\'t call other servers, so open ' + v.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/pool-app instead.'; S.mode = prev.mode; S.base = prev.base; S.err = null; renderMode(); }
  }
});
window.addEventListener('hashchange', route);
window.addEventListener('resize', () => { if (S.view === 'live' && S.state) fitTV($('#v-live [data-tv]')); if (S.view === 'biz' && S.state) fitTV($('#v-biz [data-tv]')); });   // the TV canvas follows the screen size
$('#sTable').addEventListener('change', () => render());
// ---------- ask the referee (AI agent in n8n: house rules + the live board) ----------
async function askReferee(q) {
  const log = $('#askLog'), add = (cls, txt) => { const p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = cls; p.textContent = txt; log.appendChild(p); log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight; return p; };
  add('q', q);
  if (S.mode !== 'live') { add('a', 'The AI referee is switched off in this demo. On the venue\'s own page it answers from the house rules and the live board.'); return; }
  const p = add('a wait', 'Thinking…');
  try {
    const u = new URL(S.base.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/pool-ask');
    u.searchParams.set('q', q); if (S.ticket) u.searchParams.set('ticket', S.ticket);
    const r = await fetch(u, { cache: 'no-store' }); const j = await r.json();
    p.className = 'a'; p.textContent = (j && (j.answer || j.error)) || 'No answer this time. Try again.';
  } catch (e) { p.className = 'a'; p.textContent = 'The referee can\'t be reached right now.'; }
  log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
}
$('#askForm').addEventListener('submit', e => { e.preventDefault(); const i = $('#askInput'), q = i.value.trim(); if (!q) return; i.value = ''; askReferee(q.slice(0, 200)); });
function makeQR() {
  try {
    if (!window.QRCode) return;
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    new QRCode(box, { text: location.href.split('#')[0] + '#mobile&bar=home',   // opens this bar's page in the player app
       width: 336, height: 336, colorDark: '#111111', colorLight: '#ffffff', correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.M });
    const c = box.querySelector('canvas'); S.qr = c ? c.toDataURL() : '';
  } catch (err) { S.qr = ''; }
}
makeQR();
route();
(async () => { apply(await api('state'), true); })();
// Every call to n8n is one execution, and n8n Cloud plans cap them (Starter: 2,500 a month).
// So a live page checks gently: every 4 s while something is happening (you're called or playing,
// or the board changed in the last minute), every 20 s when nothing is going on, never while the tab is hidden.
let lastSig = '', lastChange = Date.now();
const boardSig = r => JSON.stringify([r.queue.map(q => q.ticket + q.status), r.tables.map(t => [t.status, t.game && t.game.status, t.game && t.game.shots && t.game.shots.length, t.champ && t.champ.name, t.challenger && [t.challenger.name, t.challenger.present]]), r.feed[0] && r.feed[0].at]);
function pollDelay() {
  if (S.mode !== 'live') return 1000;
  const me = S.state && S.state.me;
  return (me && ['called', 'playing'].includes(me.status)) || Date.now() - lastChange < 60000 ? 4000 : 20000;
}
async function poll() {
  if (!document.hidden && !S.busy) {
    const r = await api('state');
    if (r) { const sig = boardSig(r); if (sig !== lastSig) { lastSig = sig; lastChange = Date.now(); } apply(r, true); }
  }
  setTimeout(poll, pollDelay());
}
setTimeout(poll, pollDelay());
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', async () => { if (!document.hidden && S.mode === 'live' && !S.busy) { lastChange = Date.now(); const r = await api('state'); if (r) apply(r, true); } });
setInterval(() => { if (S.mode === 'live' && S.state && !document.hidden) render(); }, 1000);   // countdowns tick between checks
setInterval(() => { if (S.auto && !S.busy) { const t = S.state && cameraTable(S.state), g = t && t.game; if (g && g.status === 'live') sendShot(true); else if (g && g.status === 'confirm') { S.auto = false; renderControls(S.state); } } }, 2600);

</script>

parameters.content:
### App page
Opening `/webhook/pool-app` returns the whole app: the player app (`#play`, the QR code opens `#mobile`), the bar app (`#bar`) and the bar TV (`#tv`). The page and the API share one address, so phones need no setup: scan the QR code on the TV, join, play.

### Bar profile auto-fill
The setup page calls `/webhook/pool-lookup?url=...` with the bar's website or Google Maps link. n8n opens the page, takes what the page states in its own data (schema.org: name, address, phone, opening hours; the Maps place name), and **AI reads the bar's page** for the rest (number of tables, table brand and size, house cues, a short "about"). The bar checks everything before saving.
For the most reliable Google data, swap **Open the page** for the Google Places API (needs an API key).
